title: CS Delivery Station Liaison , DSL
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company. To achieve this goal, we strive to exceed expectations by innovating and providing best-in-class customer support as we expand our logistics products and services including improving how we fulfill and deliver customer orders. We’re making history and the good news is that we’ve only just begun. At Amazon you get to Work with smart, passionate people who are building new products and services every day on behalf of our customers.

As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will help improve the customer experience by providing in station real-time, hands-on support to ensure our customers receive their packages on time, as promised. The role will also help connect customers with experts who can provide them the most accurate and up-to-date information about their packages. The work is beyond fulfilling and delivering customer orders; it’s making sure we put smiles on customer’s faces.

Key job responsibilities
As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will be responsible for:

- Communicating with customers directly in-person, in addition to communicating via phone and email
- Empathizing with and prioritizing customer needs
- Upholding company values and respecting every customer
- Resolving issues and setting appropriate expectations with customers
- Clearly understanding and responding appropriately to the issues that customers present
- Consistently composing grammatically correct, concise, and accurate written responses to customer issues
- Approaching problems logically and with good judgment to ensure the appropriate customer outcome
- Making quick and effective decisions on behalf of the customer
- Working a flexible Full-Time (40+ hours per week) schedule


Performing the following tasks, with or without reasonable accommodation:

- Carry, lift, push and pull up to 49 pounds
- Frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach
- Stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud (hearing protection will be provided)
- Work in an environment where the temperature may vary due to outside weather conditions and is not controlled

A day in the life
You’ll be based at one of our last-mile delivery warehouses, where Amazon’s leading logistics system operates. As orders are dispatched and delivered, you’ll be in contact with our warehouse, associates, delivery partners and customers when they need guidance. Where a customer needs to reschedule a delivery, you’ll be informing our delivery partners. Where you notice a delivery issue, you’ll get to work resolving it straight away, so that our customers get a great experience every time without having to contact Amazon.

Operating at the heart of Amazon’s logistics, you’ll develop logistical and customer expertise that sets Amazon apart. You’ll connect with our customers every day, using your in-depth understanding of our supply chain and local knowledge of delivery connections and warehouses.

About the team
Our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, and few departments have as direct an impact on that mission as our Customer Service team. We're an inclusive team who empower and look after our people, so they have the time and energy to focus on our customers’ happiness. Our goal is to reduce customer effort every way we can, helping them get the best results quickly and efficiently. We support our self-service channels to offer expert insights into our customers’ most complex issues.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- Experience in Customer Service
- Experience working with computers and Microsoft Office (including Outlook, Word, and Excel)
- Experience prioritizing and managing time effectively in dynamic environments
- Experience working with computer and web based tools

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in understanding performance metrics and developing them to measure progress against key performance indicators
- Experience with written and verbal communication and presentation
- Experience working on a merchandising/brand ambassador team for a nationally recognized consumer brand

title: Operation Lead (3x2 Night Shift), TOM - Transportation Operation Managment
descriptionHtml:
Esta é uma posição de tempo integral, permanente, presencial baseada em CNF7- Contagem, BR e não oferece benefícios de realocação. Os candidatos devem estar localizados e legalmente autorizados a trabalhar em Brazil para serem elegíveis para consideração.

A ATS (Amazon Transportation Services) está procurando por pessoas motivadas para ajudar a desenvolver um processo logístico de classe mundial que entregue mercadorias no prazo e com o melhor custo. O objetivo da nossa equipe é gerenciar com excelência a execução do frete que flui através de nossas redes de transporte, focada especificamente no gerenciamento, desenvolvimento, qualidade e desempenho de transportadoras.

Esse papel exige por uma pessoa ambiciosa. Você representará uma função crítica em nossas operações de transporte mais amplas na Amazon, enquanto trabalhamos para melhorar continuamente os níveis de serviço, prezando pela segurança em nossas instalações. Isso nos ajudará a garantir que as promessas feitas aos nossos valiosos clientes sejam cumpridas sempre.

Uma pessoa especialista em operações de transporte facilita o fluxo de informações entre diferentes partes interessadas (transportadoras/hubs/armazéns) e resolve quaisquer possíveis problemas que afetem a experiência do cliente e a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, trabalhará em operações externas com relacionamento Sort Center/Carrier, garantindo que o caminhão saia do SC para entregar os pedidos dos clientes conforme a promessa. Essa pessoa também monitora a chegada da nossa frota e aborda quaisquer possíveis problemas que ocorram durante o ciclo de vida do frete saindo do FC/SC e chegando às instalações do cliente.

Como especialista em transporte, você deve ser capaz de solucionar o problema em tempo hábil pesquisando e consultando ferramentas internas e tomando decisões em tempo real. Você deve ser capaz de entender os requisitos/ser capaz de analisar dados e observar tendências e ser capaz de impulsionar a experiência do cliente sem comprometer o tempo. Ter o conhecimento básico de Logística e deve ser capaz de se comunicar claramente na forma escrita e oral, também é necessário. A pessoa deve ser capaz de idealizar melhorias no processo e ter o zelo de levá-las à conclusão.

Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não só celebramos a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, mas também as diversas formas de trabalhar. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para o processo de entrevista ou integração, informe nossa equipe e nós o conectaremos à nossa equipe de acomodação.

Essa função funcionará em turnos 3x2 das 18h às 5h

A Amazon está comprometida com um ambiente de trabalho diverso e inclusivo. A Amazon é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e não discrimina com base em raça, origem nacional, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, status de veterano protegido, deficiência, idade ou outro status legalmente protegido.


Key job responsibilities
Comunicação com clientes externos (transportadoras, fornecedores/fornecedores) e clientes internos (varejo, finanças, suporte de software, centros de atendimento, estações de entrega, centros de classificação).
Capacidade de extrair dados de vários bancos de dados (usando Excel, Access, SQL e/ou outros sistemas de gerenciamento de dados) e realizar relatórios e análises ad hoc conforme necessário é uma vantagem.
Desenvolver e/ou compreender métricas de desempenho para ajudar a impulsionar os resultados comerciais.
Deve ser capaz de entender rapidamente o impacto comercial das tendências e tomar decisões que façam sentido com base nos dados disponíveis.
Deve ser capaz de encaminhar sistematicamente problemas ou variações nas informações e dados para os proprietários e equipes relevantes e cumprir as resoluções para garantir que sejam entregues.
Trabalhe dentro de várias restrições de tempo para atender às necessidades críticas dos negócios, ao mesmo tempo em que mede e identifica as atividades realizadas.
Excelente comunicação, tanto verbal quanto escrita, para criar uma narrativa descrevendo as descobertas semanais e as variações das metas, e apresentá-las em um fórum de revisão.
Suporta o monitoramento da chegada de veículos, correta alocação de veículos no horário necessário para carregamento, nas docas corretas, respeitando todos os padrões de segurança Amazon.
Responder às atividades de agendamento de veículos.
Prioriza-define a alocação dos veículos em doca.

A day in the life
O Ops Lead é o principal ponto de contato de transportes dentro de um centro de distribuição/ sort center. Ele(a) será o guardião de segurança e qualidade em todas as movimentações de Inbound e Outbound dentro das instalações Amazon. Garantirá a execução da rotina e a exelência nos resultados das métricas. Analisará qualquer desvio, mesmo que pequeno, para evitar problemas de qualidade e segurança. Escalará pontenciais riscos de atendimento para a liderança, e garantirá o fluxo de entrada e saída de veículos sem gargalos.

- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications

title: Sales & Operations Coordinator, Theatrical Distribution, Germany, Amazon MGM Studios
descriptionHtml:
Amazon MGM Studios seeks a Sales and Operations Coordinator, Theatrical Distribution for Germany to execute sales and distribution strategies for all theatrical releases. The position manages a portfolio of German exhibitor accounts, handling bookings, negotiations and ongoing account management, as well as managing Operations. Working closely with internal teams and external partners, the role translates sales strategy into effective release execution—driving screen count, session placement and market coverage to maximize box office performance for each title on the Amazon MGM Studios slate.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage a portfolio of German exhibitor accounts and being responsible for executing Sales strategies.
- Develop and maintain strong exhibitor relationships to drive release performance
- Assist with weekly session planning and negotiate film rental terms, screen allocations, showtime scheduling, and holdover commitments with cinema owners, circuit buyers, and independent exhibitors.
- Coordinate festival and open -air distribution activity for the slate, coordinating preview activities and develop and maintain curator/programmer relationships
- Process and manage exhibitor bookings, holdovers, and maintain accurate records of sales terms and payments in coordination with Finance team.
- Support the implementation, testing, training and setup of the Sales and Booking system
- Collaborate with the distribution and marketing teams to develop release strategies, including wide releases, and exclusive engagements, tailored to each title's commercial potential.

- Manage end-to-end delivery of trailers, posters, and promotional materials to exhibitors across Germany, coordinating with tech suppliers and Content Delivery Service providers
- Generate, distribute, and track KDMs for all theatrical bookings while troubleshooting technical delivery issues with exhibitors and suppliers
- Support the daily box office reporting for Amazon MGM bookings in internal tracking systems Prepare booking reports, and post-mortem analyses for each title; provide regular updates to senior management on theatrical performance.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in German and English at C1 level or above
- Demonstrable experience in theatrical distribution, sales, or analysis positions in the entertainment industry
- Demonstrated ability to maintain exhibitor relationships and negotiate effectively
- Strong understanding of the theatrical exhibition landscape, including major cinema chains, independent circuits, film rental models, and release windowing.
- Confidence working with spreadsheets, databases and sales tools and ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines

- Deep knowledge of the German theatrical exhibition market dynamics and trends

- Experience representing a studio at industry events and conventions

title: Senior Worldwide Specialist Solutions Architect, Containers, Application Modernization
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
Containers now run some of the most demanding systems on AWS, from real-time payment processing to large-scale AI inference. As more companies move production workloads onto Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS), Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS), AWS Fargate, and Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR), they face harder questions about scaling, cost, and security. They need architects who go deep. In this role you will help organizations worldwide answer those questions, and you will shape the container services they depend on.


You will reach customers and partners primarily through scale: workshops, reusable content, and enablement that help many organizations at once. Through these motions you will work closely with customers and partners, learning their requirements firsthand and turning them into production-ready architectures. You will bring that real-world feedback and usage data to product teams to influence feature development and future roadmaps. As a strategic technical leader in the field, you will provide architectural guidance that accelerates partner engagements worldwide while guiding an internal community of container subject matter experts.

Key job responsibilities
Serve as a trusted technical advisor on containers, helping customers and partners design, build, and run production workloads on Amazon EKS, Amazon ECS, AWS Fargate, and Amazon ECR with a focus on security, cost efficiency, and reliability.
Channel customer feedback and usage data to product teams to shape feature development and product roadmaps.
As part of the container go-to-market team, apply deep technical expertise to unblock customers' largest and most critical business challenges.
Guide and support an AWS internal community of technical subject matter experts aligned to the containers domain.
Develop reference architectures, guides, and workshops as repeatable, practical resources that scale enablement across the field and partners.

About the team
The Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) is part of AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges.

Container adoption on AWS continues to accelerate, and the team is focused on expanding reference architectures, partner integrations, and field enablement programs to meet that demand. You will join a collaborative, technically deep group where your work directly shapes how customers run their most important workloads.

About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. title: Sr Manager, UX Design , Amazon Ads
descriptionHtml:
Millions of advertisers use Amazon's creative tools to build the ads you see every day - in video, display, audio, and streaming. Behind those experiences is a design team defining how AI-generated creatives, multi-format campaigns, and brand-safe asset workflows come to life. We're hiring a UX Manager to lead that team. You'll set the vision for what every creative building experience must be, partner with design technologists to deliver code-ready prototypes, and build a team culture where scalable patterns replace one-off solutions. Your work won't sit in a backlog - it ships to advertisers worldwide and directly drives campaign performance at scale.

This is a high-impact leadership role at the intersection of generative AI, advertising technology, and advertiser experience. Your team owns end-to-end creative building workflows - from design concept through closed beta to shipped product - empowering millions of advertisers to produce high-quality creatives at scale.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead and grow a team of UX Designers who define how advertisers create, assemble, and optimize ad creatives across formats, surfaces, and funnel stages - from AI-generated assets to full campaign builds.
• Own end-to-end product design from concept to production - establish foundational design principles and interaction patterns, and collaborate with design technologists to prototype production-quality deliverables.
• Drive AI-first creative experiences - guide your team in designing generative AI workflows (image/video generation, agentic creative agents, AI-powered asset bundles) and define the interaction patterns that govern how these capabilities surface across the advertising experience.
• Set and defend the AX vision - define what every creative experience must address, build reusable frameworks and scalable patterns that teams adopt without you in the room, and push back on one-off solutions when data proves they don't serve advertisers.
• Navigate ambiguity and exercise backbone - align cross-functional stakeholders (PM, Engineering, Legal, Policy) on strategy, gatekeep intake, and find unified approaches when product owners have discordant views on implementation. Tie design decisions to measurable outcomes.
• Build mechanisms for design quality - establish critique cadences, prototyping practices, and mentoring structures that raise the bar. Partner with Design Systems to ensure creative building tools contribute to and leverage shared standards across all advertiser-facing surfaces.

About the team
The Amazon Ads Creative Experiences Design team designs the experiences advertisers use to create and manage ad creatives. Our work spans AI-powered Creative Skills (image and video generation), agentic creative workflows, multi-format campaign builders, creative preview and optimization experiences. We define the AX vision for what every creative experience must address — and ship patterns that teams adopt at scale.

We value designers who own ambiguous problems end to end, define patterns that scale without them in the room, exercise backbone to protect the advertiser experience, and tie their work to measurable business outcomes.

10+ years of design experience
5+ years of leading multi-discipline Design teams (ie. visual design, interaction design, user research, etc.) experience
Experience managing teams
Experience leading a diverse team in the delivery of experiences from end to end (user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity visuals)
Experience designing for AI-powered or generative workflows

Preferred qualifications

Experience embedding design within product teams for agile design and development collaboration
Experience in advertising technology, creative tooling, or content creation platforms

title: Market Research Prod. Manager, Strategy and Insights, Reputation Marketing Insights
descriptionHtml:
Your primary responsibility as a Product Manager on the Reputation Marketing & Insights (RMI) team will be to work with the product lead on the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of Amazon's content testing research program as a product. You will define what this research product measures, how creative and messaging insights are delivered to and adopted by stakeholders, and how the program evolves to meet changing business needs. You own the research capability and its output — the methodology, insights pipeline, and decision-making guidance it produces — while deploying and managing research vendors and third-party testing platforms as tooling rather than owning the technology itself.
The work will challenge you to be resourceful, think big while staying connected to the details, drive cross-functional alignment, and embrace a high degree of change and ambiguity at speed. The scope and scale of what we strive to achieve is immense, but it is also meaningful and energizing. This is an individual contributor role.
The right candidate possesses endless curiosity and passion for understanding perceptions and what drives them. You have proficiency in diving deep into large amounts of data and combining multiple data points to translate research into actionable insights and recommendations. You have a track record of making smart trade-offs, building alignment across teams with competing priorities, and driving crisp decisions when information is incomplete. You are an excellent communicator who can provide status updates, escalate issues, and align stakeholders through written documents, presentations, and other internal communication channels. You are a creative problem-solver who seeks to deeply understand business and communications strategy so you can shape research that informs stakeholder decision-making and messaging tactics.

Key Job Responsibilities
• Partner with the product lead on the product strategy and roadmap for the content testing research program — determining what to measure, how to deliver insights, and what to test next
• Own the end-to-end lifecycle of the content testing offering — from stakeholder management, input gathering, and research design through delivery, adoption measurement, and iteration
• Own the content testing intake queue as a product backlog, prioritizing and making smart trade-offs between depth and speed when demand exceeds capacity
• Own the analytic output and reporting standards that enable stakeholders to make go/no-go decisions with confidence; interpret results into clear, timely guidance
• Own the content testing insights repository and periodic meta-analyses that surface cross-test-round learnings and scale them across the RMI team and broader stakeholders

• Deeply understand the needs of internal customers (researchers and non-researchers) through direct engagement — observing how they use insights and identifying gaps between what they request and what they need
• Evaluate and deploy AI capabilities to accelerate research workflows, insight generation, and delivery
• Identify opportunities to simplify research processes, eliminate unnecessary complexity, and improve how insights reach decision-makers

• When needed, execute ad-hoc foundational qualitative and quantitative research, identifying actionable insights

title: Software Development Manager, AWS Network Fabric Engineering, MONA - Management Networks
descriptionHtml:
MONA builds and operates the management plane, out-of-band (OOB) network, and automation systems that keep AWS's global network infrastructure running. Today that means the tooling and platforms network engineers and automated systems use to deploy, monitor, and remediate the physical and logical network ,spanning device management, out-of-band connectivity, Initial Access and network automation at scale.

But the bigger opportunity ahead of us is bigger than keeping the lights on: we are building the next generation of management networks for AWS, purpose-built to support Resilient Network Graphs (RNG), Machine Learning, and Intent-Driven Controls. That means designing and developing controllers across every layer of the business, from device-level control planes to fleet-wide orchestration systems and using software, not manual process, to solve problems that have historically been solved by people, runbooks, and tickets. This is a green-field, product-building mandate as much as an operations one: we want engineers who see a recurring network problem and build a product to solve it, not just a fix.

We're hiring a Software Development Manager to lead a team based in San Jose, combining software engineers and network development engineers. This is a hybrid technical/network organization: you'll manage people who write production automation and controller software alongside engineers who own network-facing systems and integrations, and you're expected to be credible with both disciplines. You'll set the technical bar for how we design controllers, and the product bar for how we turn internal network pain points into reusable solutions for the rest of AWS.

Key job responsibilities
Own delivery and technical direction for a team of SDEs and NDEs designing and building the next generation of management network controllers, spanning device, fabric, and fleet-level control planes
- Set technical strategy for evolving MONA's network platforms to support Resilient Network Graphs (RNG), Machine Learning, and Intent-Driven Controls, moving from manual/runbook-driven operations to software-driven, intent-based control loops
- Drive a product mindset on the team: identify recurring network problems across the business, turn them into reusable controllers and platforms, and own their adoption as internal products with real customers
- Partner with peer SDMs, NDMs and Sr. Managers across MONA's other sub-teams to align controller architecture, roadmaps, and dependencies
- Drive hiring, performance management, and career growth for a team spanning two disciplines (software and network engineering)
- Represent SJC-based engineering in org-wide planning, ensuring the site has a strong technical voice in controller architecture and prioritization decisions
- Balance operational excellence (on-call, incident response, fleet health) with delivery of new controller products and automation roadmaps
- Contribute to MONA's broader network, using data (dwell times, ticket throughput, fleet growth) to decide which network problems get solved with a new controller/product vs. incremental automation

A day in the life
You start with fleet signals, a change shipped caught a degrading link before it became an incident, and you dig into the one case it missed. Mid-morning is a design review on how customers are actually utilizing the network and planning port capacity, and how that translates into clean platform API contracts between device-level hardware and controller software. Afternoons mix cross-team architecture alignment with peer SDMs, 1:1s and promotion coaching, and strategising how to present your team's progress and roadmap to leadership. You close the day deciding which recurring network problem becomes the next product.

About the team
MONA sits inside AWS Network Fabric Engineering (NFE) and owns the management plane, out-of-band networks, and automation that keep AWS's global network running. The org currently spans four sub-teams, expanding to six, each a blend of network and software engineers working side by side rather than in separate disciplines. This role leads the San Jose site, one of four hubs alongside Sydney, Seattle, and Dublin, reporting to the Sr. Manager for MONA. The fleet is growing fast (545K to 985K devices by end of 2027), and the team's mandate is shifting from keeping that growth operable to redesigning the control layer underneath it.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience with large-scale fleet management, automation-driven operations, or SLO/operational excellence frameworks
- Background in network operations, data center infrastructure, or Network engineering

title: Senior Product Manager, Amazon Customer Service
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Customer Service (Amazon CS) organization is seeking a Sr Product Manager to own the end-to-end Service Design experience for Alexa products and services.

This role owns conceptualizing, building, and enhancing customer service experiences that impact millions of Alexa customers, in a space of strategic importance where the problem, opportunity, and strategy may not yet be defined. You will work backwards from customer pain points to define product vision, write strategy documents (PRFAQs, narratives, roadmaps), and drive execution across product, engineering, design, and operations teams. You will define success through measurable outcomes, distinguishing between output metrics like defects eliminated and effort reduction, and outcome metrics like customer satisfaction, engagement, and quality of experience.

As the critical intersection point for customer needs, business goals, and technical possibilities, you will lead cross-organizational initiatives that drive value with increased product engagement, or lower cost to serve by increasing operational efficiencies. You will apply one-way and two-way door judgment to high-stakes decisions, challenge assumptions, and establish strategic frameworks adoptable by other teams. You will embrace emerging technology shifts and adopt industry trends to define the best-in-class service offering to secure customer loyalty. While driving multi-year investments that reshape the CS landscape, you'll instrument new success measures where necessary as you secure cross-functional commitment to build solutions to mitigate customer pain points.

This leader earns trust and influences without authority at the Director and VP levels across Product, Marketing, Engineering, Finance, Legal, PR and Operations teams by leveraging data and grounding recommendations based on business priorities or holistic organizational needs.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the 3 to 5 year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Alexa Customer Service, spanning Hardware, Digital Services and third-party integrations. Drive clarity where strategy is undefined, and create frameworks that enable organizational action.
- Champion exceptional customer experiences grounded in utility, intuitiveness, and simplicity. Partner with design on mockups and prototypes, scrutinizing details while aligning with strategic goals. Ensure customer validation reflects diverse perspectives and drive strategic CX conversations across your area.
- Demonstrate deep technical curiosity. Evaluate engineering proposals, ask the right questions, and ensure sound trade-offs. Understand key architecture decisions, the assumptions behind them, and whether those assumptions still hold. Bring performance, scale, and flexibility perspectives into engineering conversations early.
- Identify and embrace technology shifts before they become obvious. Drive multi-year technology investments and evaluate complex technical proposals. Apply AI and agentic capabilities to accelerate development, improve decisions, and unlock innovation.
- Influence without authority across CS and other VP organizations, building alignment across teams with different priorities. Present regularly to Directors and VPs, align on OP1/OP2/goals, and own executive engagement for critical issues. Amplify impact by developing others and actively recruiting PM talent.
- Serve as the recognized CS Voice of the Customer in product design, ideation, and launch readiness, personally driving cross-functional VP level goals. Engage senior decision-makers to uncover non-obvious insights. Define CS requirements, hold launches to a high experience bar, and advocate for prioritization of solutions that address customer feedback drivers.

A day in the life
On any given day, you will drive strategic conversations with senior leaders, leveraging data to influence investments and priorities to enhance the Alexa device and digital product Customer Service experience - advocating for upstream defect elimination, empowering customers with self-service capabilities or optimizing our human-in-the-loop support offering. You serve as the connective tissue between CS service design, operations, product line stakeholders, and partner organizations, setting priorities and driving alignment across teams with different objectives.

You will present investment narratives in Director and VP level product reviews, fielding questions on customer impact, scalability, business sustainability, and competitive positioning. You will balance setting the 3 to 5 year vision with near-term execution: defining cross-org launch requirements, authoring OP1/OP2 narratives, building consensus on bold bets, and measuring impact across your portfolio.

You will drive multi-year technology investment decisions, evaluating how agentic capabilities could reshape the CS experience, forming views on ROI and market timing, and determining when to make bold bets versus invest in further validation. You will define investment areas within operational planning cycles, build cross-functional consensus on long-term strategic direction, and establish the metrics frameworks and measurement strategies that other teams adopt.

About the team
D2SD (Digital and Devices Service Design) is part of the Customer Service Experience (CSX) team within Amazon CS, and owns the end-to-end customer service experience across Amazon's Digital and Device portfolio. We are the advocates for the CS experience for customers using our device and digital products, and relentlessly work to remove customer facing defects, improving quality and shaping how millions of customers use our products and get help. Our insights drive product improvements upstream, and our mechanisms set the standard for Customer Obsession within Amazon Customer Service.

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

title: Operations Engineer, RSR Start Up
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 16, 2026

Amazon created one of the most sophisticated supply chains in the world. From the introduction of Amazon Prime, to the use of advanced technology for package delivery; Amazon consistently drives change from the front of the pack.

As an Operations Engineer, you will lead and manage the lifecycle of challenging cross-functional projects, developing and delivering the next generation of sortation and distribution solutions. You are a customer obsessed leader that will play an integral part in planning and implementation of the facility network infrastructure including new builds, retrofits, expansions and program initiatives. Partnering with internal customers and internal/external stakeholders to engage as a team and ensure a timely handover will be part of your critical tasks.

Key competencies of this position include insisting on the highest standards ensuring that contracted resources meet schedule, budgetary, safety and driving quality targets; analyzing and deep diving systems performance, inventing and simplifying solutions that allow for improved processes and results; and providing technical expertise to internal customers and stakeholders.

Key job responsibilities
•Work independently with internal and external teams to successfully manage the lifecycle of the challenging projects, and act as owner in delivering on projects objectives and targets. Projects may span organizations or geographies in support of business objectives.
•Actively participate in firm engineering reviews, and make tangible impact on the proposed solutions on an individual system or its components, on the overall systems architecture, and on facility processes .
•Partner with internal teams, stakeholders and external vendors to set project priorities, establish milestones, and drive schedules to meet deadlines. Proactively assess stakeholders’ dependencies and milestones, problem-solve and drive solutions to mitigate the impact from the issues.
•Lead and coordinate all execution efforts in delivering systems and automated equipment designs per established standards and guidelines. Perform equipment/systems installation, throughput and safety qualifications. Simplify, optimize, remove bottlenecks and provide feedback while resolving difficult system problems or technical deficiencies.
•Lead effective meetings by setting the objectives, putting the right people in the room and driving detailed business and technical discussions/alignment. Document meetings discussions, decisions and future steps ensuring alignment on expectations with internal partner teams and outside vendors.
•Promptly and accurately communicate project status, risk analysis and risk mitigation plans. Effectively answer project questions in detail, and regularly produce clear and concise summaries for the projects to leadership/management team.
•Competently articulate system and/or equipment designs, including layouts, technical specifications and functional capabilities, to internal customers and partner teams.
•Efficiently manage change order controls, purchase orders, and invoice validation/approvals.
•Excel at building strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders across multiple projects
•Identify and lead process improvement initiatives that improve the Engineering and cross-teams’ efficiencies, optimizing the teams’ value and delivery. Through collaboration, generate high-quality, cost-effective solutions in compressed periods of time.
•Travel up to 80% domestically although travel intensity can be variable and consist of up to three weeks in a row, including weekends.

A day in the life
You are managing quality of implementation through multiple projects that can vary in scope, complexity and duration.

Daily tasks may comprise of site coordination with operations teams and contractors on project execution activities or changes; deep diving project progress, schedule and resources, while identifying barriers, creating solutions and driving resolutions.

You may be facilitating the planning and/or implementation meetings with projects’ stakeholders, ensuring alignment in objectives, expectations, and the next steps; you would capture and publish detailed notes after each meeting to drive ownership and follow-through on the actions and decisions.

Reviewing/approving audit mechanisms and documentation is one of the essential tasks, and you may be tracking the programmatic week on week installation opportunities with the internal automation teams.

You may be brainstorming and developing workaround solutions while mitigating the project delays or design issues.

As a part of the acceptance testing you may be performing systems installation quality, safety, throughput and performance qualifications, frequently communicating the progress to internal and external stakeholders.

In addition, you may be supporting/training other engineering team members, utilizing the knowledge of Amazon’s safety, mechanical, electrical and controls installation standard and guidelines.

About the team
At Amazon, we are all Owners and leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from firm engineering to project execution and final hand-off to our customers. We are a diverse, upbeat, creative team of engineers and managers working on a daily basis to ensure that our internal customers have capabilities to deliver on the Customer Promise.

We not only build, but we are also consistently improving our capabilities at Amazon. Continuous
improvement is the ongoing enhancement of our systems designs, through incremental and
breakthrough developments. We are continually raising the quality bar, and are never satisfied.

We seek to improve through captured lessons learned, that are incorporated back into our mechanisms as a way to perpetually improve upon the next design and processes iterations.
We continually learn, grow and develop throughout the organization and our Subject Matter Expertise is leveraged globally.

We are the Team! We collaborate, support, help and leverage each other in delivering on the business objectives.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience with Microsoft Office products & applications
- Experience in construction or project management

- 2+ years of vendor management experience

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery
descriptionHtml:
AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (DRS) is a disaster recovery service provided by AWS that enables organizations to minimize downtime and data loss with fast, reliable recovery of on-premises and cloud-based applications. DRS uses cost-effective AWS resources to maintain an up-to-date copy of source servers on AWS, allowing for point-in-time recovery and failback to the primary site after an issue is resolved.

We are looking for passionate software developers to join out team and help to solve a challenging set of problems in a space packed full of opportunities. In this role, you will participate in the full life cycle of AWS services including requirements definition, software design, implementation and ownership of the product.

The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic with working on mission critical applications that operate at scale. They will also be passionate about technology and working with the best software developers in the world to innovate and provide our customers an unparalleled experience.

Key job responsibilities
As a key member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence on our product strategy. descriptionHtml:
Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.


Key job responsibilities
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
- Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
- Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
- Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
- Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
- Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
- Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort

A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

About the team
Die Logistikabteilung bei Amazon (AMZL) ist für die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ zuständig – also die Auslieferung unserer Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern. Wir denken kreativ und realisieren Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von physischen Produkten an unsere Kund:innen zu liefern. Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Diese Tätigkeiten werden von zwei Mitarbeitergruppen ausgeführt. Unsere „internen“ Mitarbeitenden bereiten Millionen von Produkten auf den Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor. Unser Team ist menschenorientiert und hilfsbereit. Das ist besonders wichtig, weil viele unserer Mitarbeitenden in Nachtschichten arbeiten. Unser Fokus liegt vorwiegend auf dem operativen Betrieb. An den meisten unserer Standorte wird rund um die Uhr gearbeitet.
Unsere „Außendienst“-Mitarbeitenden arbeiten währenddessen mit Amazon Flex – einem Auftragnehmer-Netzwerk für die Lieferung. Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

Basic qualifications

- Erfolgreich absolviertes Hochschulstudium (Bachelor- oder Master) vor Arbeitsbeginn
- Fortgeschrittene Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Relevante Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Datenanalysen

Preferred qualifications

- Aktuelles Studium oder kürzlich erworbener Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss im Bereich Logistik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
- Interesse eine Führungsaufgabe und ein eigenes Team mit Mitarbeitenden aus der ganzen Welt zu übernehmen

- Erfahrung in einer Logistikumgebung

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are breaking new ground with every device we design, from custom silicon to secure software, to enable innovative satellite and ground systems. Be part of a team that pushes the boundaries of satellite communications technology to make global connectivity a reality.

As an Device Software Development Engineer on the Amazon Leo Government (ALG) team, you will design and develop embedded software for Amazon Leo’s satellite and ground systems. You’ll work on fault-tolerant, real-time platforms, collaborating closely with hardware, systems, and product teams to deliver secure, reliable, and high-performance solutions.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the next generation of space-based communication systems with minimal legacy constraints. Your work will directly support critical government initiatives, enabling secure and high-performance communication systems for U.S. and allied missions.

This role can sit in either Northridge, El Segundo, or Arlington with U.S. relocation benefits offered. On-site work is required 5 days a week.

• Debug and resolve complex hardware-software integration issues using tools like logic analyzers and oscilloscopes.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless hardware-software interaction and system reliability.

We collaborate closely with hardware and systems teams to deliver secure, high-performance solutions for mission-critical applications.

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager - Storage, AWS Hardware Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 16, 2026

AWS operates the world's largest fleet of storage servers powering Compute and AI/ML workloads at cloud scale. Our team designs, builds, and operates this fleet — solving systemic hardware issues and building systems that detect and prevent recurrence, so customers experience the highest quality of service.

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive end-to-end delivery of Storage servers across our global fleet. You will coordinate cross-functional engineering teams spanning hardware, firmware, and software, manage ODM partnerships across multiple continents, and establish closed-loop quality systems that drive continuous improvements. This role requires technical depth to translate engineering constraints into program risk, combined with program management excellence to deliver complex hardware at global scale.

What You Will Do
You will own programs where the critical path runs through silicon, firmware, and software teams simultaneously. You will translate ambiguity into structure: turning a fleet telemetry signal into a corrective action plan with quantified failure rates, a customer requirement into a new platform milestone with EVT/DVT/PVT gates, or a manufacturing escape into a design change with updated validation criteria. You will drive decisions on program trade-offs — adjusting scope when qualification gates slip, balancing deployment speed against fleet risk, and determining when to accept interim mitigations instead of holding for root-cause fixes. When a large scale of Storage servers depends on your program landing on time, you are the one ensuring hardware readiness, qualification completeness, and operational handoff happen without gaps.

Why You Will Love It
The world's most advanced frontier models are trained on the platforms you help build. Your programs launch the Storage servers that power the largest Compute and AI/ML workloads on the planet. You will see your decisions reflected in fleet reliability metrics within weeks of deployment. The team is small and high-trust — you own programs end to end from concept through production, with direct access to leadership and engineering alike.

The Ideal Candidate
You have deep technical intuition across hardware and software — enough to challenge engineering decisions, not just track them. You thrive in ambiguity, bringing structure to programs where requirements, timelines, and dependencies are still forming. You align priorities across teams in different organizations, and you escalate with data, not noise. You actively mentor and develop others — TPMs and engineers alike. You contribute to hiring, promotion assessments, and raising the bar for program management practices in your organization.



Key job responsibilities
• You manage large, complex technology initiatives, delivering critical solutions, significant improvements, new mechanisms, or deprecating systems that are no longer needed.
• You successfully manage all stages (from concept to delivery).
• You understand the architecture of the systems you work with (e.g., workflows, APIs, runtime characteristics, design limitations, and maintenance requirements). You influence team technical priorities and business strategy through data-driven contributions.
• You communicate ideas effectively, verbally and in writing, to a wide range of audiences including Directors and VPs. You foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues (build consensus). You partner successfully with customers, stakeholders, and engineering teams.
• Your program management practices set a great example to others. You routinely and efficiently deliver the right things. You define clear goals and objectives. You drive crisp decisions in your program area about what projects move forward and in what priority order. You proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your team and stakeholders with plans for mitigation before they become roadblocks.
• You are a simplifier. You judiciously add, refine, and remove procedures. By applying project management best practices, you increase the productivity and effectiveness of the teams you work with.


A day in the life
You start the day syncing with ODM partners across time zones on build status and open engineering actions. Mid-morning, you run an engineering review connecting firmware, software, and hardware teams to unblock a qualification gate. In the afternoon, you triage a fleet reliability issue with operations data, drive alignment on corrective actions, and update executive stakeholders on program risk posture. You end the day reviewing NPI milestone readiness and ensuring the next design review has clear entry criteria.

About the team
The Hardware Engineering S3 Platform and OEM Drives team is a group of engineers and technical program managers directly responsible for launching Storage servers into the AWS fleet. Located in Seattle, Denver, and Cupertino, we collaborate with global development teams and ODM partners to deliver next-generation Compute and AI/ML infrastructure deployed in datacenters worldwide. We move fast with small, empowered teams delivering end-to-end, from server conception through fleet-scale operations.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience in taking a product from conception & definition phase through engineering design and taking it to market

Preferred qualifications

- 8+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Experience prioritizing and delivering projects on time in a fast-moving environment
- Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
- 7+ years of server, storage, networking, or large-scale distributed systems experience
- 3+ years experience in product development working with third party vendors (CM/OEM/ODM)

descriptionHtml:
Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. To keep our operations network secure and assure operational continuity, we are looking for a proactive and solution-based professional who wants to join our team as Security and Loss Prevention (SLP) Expert. In this key role, you will deliver security as a service to our operational sites across the end-to-end supply chain to protect our people and prevent loss.

Key job responsibilities
• Support resilience of our business operations by contributing to emergency and crisis planning for sites within your area of responsibility
• Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards
• Serve as point of contact for and coordinate measures to manage risk with local management and external partners (e.g., law enforcement agencies and industry associations) on all security-related matters
• Ensure compliance of your assigned sites with Amazon global security standards
• Own Security and Loss Prevention-related projects on the local, regional, and country level


A day in the life
As an SLP Expert, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analysing data reports, and conducting interviews.

Your findings contribute to identifying vulnerabilities in our processes and you identify and drive mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality. Furthermore, you identify and act upon initiatives improving our physical security infrastructure and contribute directly to the budgetary planning for our external suppliers.

You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams across all management levels and manage the implementation of our Security and Loss Prevention plan.

About the team
Sitting within the Global Security Operations organisation, Security and Loss Prevention supports the accomplishment of Amazon´s business targets and the strengthening of our brand by effectively protecting against relevant threats and by managing security and loss prevention risks that could:

• Put our associates and customers under jeopardy
• Disrupt the continuity of our business operations
• Inflict damage to our assets
• Have adverse impact on our brand reputation

Working in partnership with our stakeholders, we secure the Amazon supply chain end-to-end and promote security during business conversations. We do this by preventing security and loss prevention-related risks and vulnerabilities as early as possible, intervening in unfolding incidents to minimize any negative impact as well as thoroughly investigating security-related incidents to identify and remove root causes, preventing re-occurrence.

title: Senior Reliability Maintenance Engineering Technician, RME
descriptionHtml:
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team is central to Amazon's commitment to innovation. As Amazon evolves and adapts, this team makes sure that the tools and technologies we use do as well. As a Senior RME Technician, you'll help us stay one step ahead, adopting the latest technologies and identifying new and efficient ways of working. In this role, you’ll pay close attention to our processes to help maintain our high standards, and you’ll put in place upgrades to take that standard even higher.

Key job responsibilities
- Demonstrate best practice on using equipment safely and monitor teams to ensure everyone follows the correct processes
- Keep track of equipment performance through visual checks, condition-based monitoring, and preventative maintenance tasks and schedule additional servicing when required
- Supervise technicians on shift to support their development and act as the first point of contact for Reliability Maintenance Engineers
- Solve issues in equipment to reduce downtime for operations so they can process packages as quickly as possible
- Support in finding ways to continually improve systems and standardise processes across the EU network

A day in the life
Our RME Technicians are based on-site, so they can respond quickly to any machinery issues. You’ll carry out a range of planned preventative maintenance to our sites’ equipment to make sure it’s working safely. As an RME Technician, you’ll also respond promptly to breakdowns, investigating, finding, and implementing solutions as quickly as possible. You’ll also make suggestions for long-term improvements.

Working alongside senior colleagues, you’ll undertake day-to-day maintenance tasks and will liaise with contractors if you need external expertise. You’ll work on a range of shifts to make sure our sites are supported around the clock – allowing Amazon to deliver at the speed we’re known for.

About the team
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. Some of our people are leaders, who oversee the team as they work on exciting technology – some of which only exists at Amazon.

From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. This includes keeping buildings legally compliant, so everyone is safe, and our sites are operating at maximum efficiency. There are lots of opportunities for progression, both within the RME team and more widely across Amazon.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. We often work during early or late hours to carry out maintenance with minimal disruption, including night shifts. If we spot a better way to do something, we have the skills and the opportunity to develop and introduce completely new processes or cutting-edge tech like Amazon Robotics and our Complex Item Sorter.

Basic qualifications

- NVQ Level 3 in Mechanical, Electrical or Mechatronics, or completed a 4-year UK certified apprenticeship
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Relevant experience in a technical leadership role
- Relevant experience working in both electrical and mechanical disciplines
- Relevant experience in automation or material handling equipment environments
- Advanced proficiency in verbal and written English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in a multi-contractor and multi-site working environment
- Understanding of PLC based controls systems and statutory compliance requirements
- Experience using computerised maintenance management systems to plan proactive maintenance and record reactive tasks
- A degree preferably in a technical discipline or operations

title: Senior Technical Infrastructure Program Manager, Field Engineering Portfolio
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Field Engineering Team is the engineering owner for the lifecycle of AWS data centers. This includes supporting new designs/innovations through data center end-of-life, with a focus on root cause analysis of failures, capacity and availability improvement, and optimization of the existing fleet.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Technical Infrastructure Program Manager to lead the Global Data Center Performance Indicator (DCPI) Program for AWS Field Engineering. DCPIs turn continuous signals from data center infrastructure into early warning of equipment risk, so the fleet moves from reacting to failures to preventing them. In this role, you will set the global strategy for how AWS measures and protects the health of its data center infrastructure. You will decide which risks the fleet must detect and in what order, expand the program into new domains where regulatory requirements and AWS’s public reputation are at stake, and set the direction for the best way to scale the program so AWS operations become more efficient and intelligent, while delivering world-class uptime for our customers.

You will bring deep technical expertise in data center mechanical, electrical, and controls systems, and use it to set the technical direction for an AI-empowered, machine learning–integrated platform that will lead AWS toward its vision of scaling effortlessly. You will partner closely with multiple engineering disciplines, including mechanical/electrical, reliability and quality, software, data science, and data engineering teams, as well as operations and sustainability partners. You will make strategic decisions on program priorities, investment, and overall direction, connecting long-term program vision with the rapid growth of AWS.

You must be adept at identifying and communicating upcoming risks, issues, and bottlenecks, and be instrumental in resolving them, often across multiple organizational boundaries. You must possess a strong sense of organization, communication, and team-building skills that foster robust working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the strategy and roadmap for global infrastructure health and performance programs, prioritizing investment by risk, customer impact, and scale.
• Define the performance indicators, signals, thresholds, and data-quality standards that measure the health of data center infrastructure, and hold them to a high technical bar.
• Drive programs across regions and organizational boundaries, aligning engineering, operations, software, and data science partners on priorities, standards, and success metrics.
• Set the technical requirements for the tools and platforms that build, deploy, and scale performance monitoring, and partner with software and machine learning (ML) teams on where automation and anomaly detection add the most value.
• Extend program coverage to new equipment types and domains, and establish mechanisms for transitioning mature capabilities to operational owners.
• Full lifecycle ownership from risk identification to global fleet-wide resolution, including standards and processes for tracking, reporting, and closing actions.
• Prepare narratives for executive leadership with recommendations that articulate decision points relative to cost, timing, availability, and strategic trade-offs.

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Fulfillment Technology (AFT), Platform Engineering and Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers the physical engine at the heart of Amazon — magically turning your click of a button into packages at your door. Within AFT, the Labor Insights team builds and operates the platform that tracks on associate labor performance across Amazon's entire global warehouse network. Labor Insights' suite of 18+ services supports ~1 million associates and 70,000+ daily portal users across 9,800+ facilities and 10 business lines — ingesting over 19 billion labor events annually to produce the real-time productivity reports that warehouse managers rely on to run their operations every day. We leverage AWS technologies, stream processing, and AI/ML to build distributed, highly available systems that operate at massive scale.

Are you ready for a challenge? As a Software Development Engineer on the Labor Insights team, you will build the next generation of Amazon's labor management platform — designing systems that ingest billions of labor events from warehouse floor tools and time clock systems, aggregate them through multi-stage pipelines, and serve real-time productivity reports to operations managers across the globe. You will own design and development of distributed systems that refresh reports every 10–15 minutes across 3 global regions while maintaining 99.9% availability. You will contribute to a wide range of projects — from event processing pipelines and aggregation engines to reporting APIs, modern React-based portals, and AI-powered configuration tools. Most excitingly, you will help drive refresh of the existing tool, an AI-first greenfield initiative to rebuild the platform from the ground up using modern stream-based architecture, eliminating a decade of technical debt and delivering near real-time metrics. You will be involved in all aspects of the software development cycle including scoping, design, implementation, testing, and delivery. A commitment to teamwork, hustle, and strong communication skills are absolute requirements. Creating reliable, scalable, and high-performance services requires exceptional technical expertise. If you have that expertise, are customer-centric, and motivated about building systems that operate at global scale, then we want to talk to you!

Key job responsibilities
* Design, develop, and test software components across Labor Insights' ingestion, aggregation, reporting, and configuration layers — handling labor events, time clock punches, employee location tracking, and productivity report generation
* Build new services using AI-assisted development practices, leveraging tools like Amazon Q and Bedrock to achieve high-velocity delivery on greenfield systems
* Design large-scale data processing solutions using DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, S3, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Lambda, and stream processing frameworks (Cosmos/Flink) optimized for high throughput and low-latency access
* Drive service consolidation and modernization — migrating from legacy infrastructure to Native AWS (NAWS) with full CI/CD pipelines
* Participate in definition of coding standards and apply them in code and design reviews
* Provide estimates for development tasks and negotiate timelines with project leaders
* Mentor junior team members and help them acquire critical skills and best practices
* Document and communicate technical concepts to team members and stakeholders
* Participate in deep technical discussions, where you stand up for your ideas and work with team members to find the best solution for the customer
* Identify technical and project risks and take initiative to mitigate them

A day in the life
Full-cycle ownership. You contribute to all aspects of the software development cycle — from scoping and design through implementation, testing, and delivery of features that provide labor performance visibility to Amazon's global fulfillment operations.

Billions-scale data processing. You build systems that ingest 19+ billion labor events per year from warehouse floor tools, time clock systems, and employee location heartbeats. You design multi-stage aggregation pipelines that process this data into PPR and PPA reports refreshed every 10–15 minutes, served to 70K+ daily users across 9,800+ facilities.

AWS-native architecture. You leverage the full AWS stack — DynamoDB for hot data storage, S3 for historical data, PostgreSQL for aggregated reports, SQS/SNS for event-driven processing, EventBridge and Lambda for serverless job orchestration, and Cosmos/Flink for stream processing. You architect for 99.9% availability across 3 global regions (NA, EU, FE).
AI-first development. You pioneer AI-assisted engineering practices — using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, and AI-powered tools to accelerate greenfield development at 20X traditional velocity. You build intelligent systems like AI-powered configuration assistants, automated intake routing, and GenAI-driven operational tooling.

Modernization at scale. You modernize a 15+ year-old platform serving every fulfillment center worldwide — consolidating 23+ services into a clean microservices architecture, rebuilding the portal experience in React from legacy JSP/jQuery, and transitioning from batch to stream processing, all while maintaining zero-downtime operations.

About the team
About Labor Insights: We build Amazon's global labor management platform — the system of record for measuring associate performance across every fulfillment center, sort center, delivery station, and grocery facility worldwide. Labor Insights tracks how ~1 million associates spend their time, producing the productivity reports (PPR, PPA, attendance, Time Off Task) that operations managers use to make staffing decisions, identify bottlenecks, and ensure customer shipments go out on time.

What Makes This Role Exciting:

* Build FCLM 2.0 from the ground up — a once-in-a-career opportunity to greenfield a platform that runs Amazon's global workforce visibility, using AI-first development to deliver in months what would take years through traditional approaches
* Pioneer stream processing — transition from batch to real-time with sub-minute latencies using Cosmos/Flink, fundamentally changing how Amazon tracks labor performance
* Build a multi-tenant platform (FCLM FLEX) — design a configurable translation layer that recasts PPR and PPA as flexible views on the same underlying data, eliminating duplicate pipelines and enabling third-party teams to create custom labor views without engineering support
* Reimagine the portal experience — rebuild the portal used by 70K+ daily users from legacy JSP/jQuery into a modern React application with accessibility, localization, and scalable access controls
* Expand to new businesses — onboard Amazon Grocery (Fresh, Whole Foods) and other new business lines in 2026+, scaling the platform to new node types and labor models
* Build AI-powered tools — design intelligent systems using Amazon Bedrock for automated configuration management, request intake, and operational copilots that serve 1.5M workers globally
* Massive impact — every feature you build is used by tens of thousands of warehouse managers the same day; Labor Insights’ operations save an estimated $25M+ annually


Our tenets:

* Build for Scale: Design generically to support multiple use cases beyond Labor Insights
* Service Generalization for Multi-Tenancy: Build abstractions that work across all businesses
* No Data Filtering by Default: Accept all incoming data, build flexible views on top

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: WHS Multi-site Manager (AMZL), Workplace Health and Safety (AMZL)
descriptionHtml:
The WHS Multi-site Manager (AMZL) will be responsible for 5 to 7 Delivery Stations to execute company Safety policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and kaizens, this individual will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in our processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our Associates.

The WHS Multi-site Manager (AMZL) must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the Operations Team and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis.

The WHS Multi-site Manager (AMZL) must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. This individual must instruct and train Operations Leaders in company WHS policies and assist the regional teams in incorporating our WHS standards at their sites.

The WHS Multi-site Manager (AMZL) will be required to identify best practices and incorporate these best practices into our standards to continuously improve company Safety policies.

The WHS Multi-site Manager (AMZL) will be required to possess WHS program and relevant safety, environmental and ergonomic knowledge and demonstrates this expertise when working with Operations.

The WHS Multi-site Manager (AMZL) will be responsible to lead a team of WHS Officers in their region. This individual must create and execute leadership development plans for their WHS Associates on their team. They must communicate safety team expectations and give frequent and appropriate feedback to their WHS teams and ensure they are executing to the core competencies of an Amazon professional. This individual must also demonstrate the ability to judge and assess WHS talent and select appropriate bench strength to current and future business needs.


Key job responsibilities
• Manage overall compliance with local requirements and authorities.
• Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon WHS Policies and regulatory requirements
• Measure the regions and sites’ performance against published requirements in WHS policies. For all deficiencies, identify a plan for the site to implement and fix all identified deficiencies.
• Ensure WHS recordkeeping and data integrity and provides Operations with accurate reporting and metrics to support business WHS initiatives.
• Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations. Deliver quality projects on time to Operations.
• Analyze WHS metrics and review incident weekly and monthly incident trends to discover trends to justify the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
• Audit recordkeeping practices and Global WHS Database entries to ensure compliance to global WHS standards and local regulations.
• Audit the workplace organization and Associate behaviors to ensure that training, auditing and scoring methods are accurate and consistent.
• Manage and mentor the region WHS Officers and WHS Associates in your assigned sites.
• Spend time at the sortation centers, and delivery stations, and seek input from WHS teams, Associates and leaders on WHS program improvement opportunities.
• Ensure open communication on status of progress and resolution against these suggestions.
• Ensure site leadership and Associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy. Audit the quality, delivery (including qualifications of the trainer), and effectiveness of all required WHS training.
• Review for effectiveness the deployed WHS tools and revise to ensure continual improvement.
• Partner with corporate and other regional field WHS personnel to leverage global WHS standards.
