title: Transportation Associate
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to help Amazon deliver world class service in its transportation operations? Transportation Associates will perform trailer moves in the trailer yard, coordinate yard activities (such as checking in trailers, traffic flow, internal communications with operations, etc.), conduct yard audits, complete applicable driver training programs (Hostler, Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) School, etc.), and operate multiple vehicle types based on business need (including but not limited to hostlers and day cabs) to support Amazon’s transportation network. Benefits of being a Transportation Associate include the opportunity to work outside and understand the new and exciting world of transportation operations.
As a Transportation Associate you will:
• Make safety a priority by adhering to company rules and regulations. You will follow and enforce safety measures and policies to all who operate vehicles on behalf of Amazon and those who enter the yard, including vendors and senior team members
• Perform various functions within the yard, support site operations teams, internal transportation field teams, and external carriers, as needed, to ensure all trailers arrive and depart on time with zero defects and to maintain workflow for buildings.
• Be professionally trained to operate Commercial Motor Vehicles (CMVs) on non-public roads or in yard to move trailers to/from dock and parking locations.
• Learn Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations and comply with company policies, procedures of those DOT regulations (size, weight, route designations, parking, trailer designations, violation and incident reporting requirements, break periods, etc.)
• Complete driver vehicle inspection reports on equipment and notify managers of any maintenance or delivery issues encountered.
• Follow hostler and delivery schedules, track and report working hours and breaks at appropriate times in compliance with Amazon policy and federal and state regulations, adhere to yard safety policies, obey all applicable traffic laws, and drive in accordance with weather/road conditions.
• Support the business on an as needed basis by serving as a peer trainer and/or working at nearby site locations within the area
• Drive, maneuver, and load/unload a truck using approved equipment (pallet jack, etc.).
What else does the team have to offer? We’re glad you asked!
• Opportunity to work outside and drive different commercial motor vehicles in the yard and over the road
• Exposure to different Amazon site types including NACF, NASC, Air, AMZL & AMXL.
• Long-term growth potential via comprehensive training in transportation with Amazon.
• Dependent on business need, you may have the opportunity to earn your Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) paid for by Amazon.

Join ATS! ATS is one of the fastest growing business lines within Amazon over the past 5 Years with continued growth to come!

If requested due to business need, Transportation Associates must obtain their Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) and Driver Qualification File (DQF) and utilize it as a condition of the role, paid for by Amazon. If Associate is requested to become CDL and DQF certified to drive Over-the-Road for Amazon, this position becomes regulated by the Department of Transportation (DOT) and follows regulations issued by the DOT’s Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA). Candidate must hold a valid driver’s license for the state in which they reside and be eligible to drive in accordance with DOT requirements. For Department of Labor/Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration roles (roles for which you receive a CDL), English proficiency is required per federal regulation.
The timing of this requirement is dependent on business need. Continuing in the position with CDL and DQF certification is contingent upon the successful completion of a DOT-regulated pre-employment background screening, a DOT physical and Amazon’s pre-employment drug test.
Basic qualifications
• Hold a valid and active driver’s license
• High School or equivalent diploma
• Candidates must be 21 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirement and safety guidelines in English.
• Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, reach and ascend/descend stairs
• Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
• Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications
• Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills with diverse audiences
• Experience building strong, collaborative relationships with colleagues and outside vendors
• A valid Class A Commercial Driver’s License (CDL)
• Completion of Career Choice Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) Course

- Are 21 years of age or older

- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach

title: Solutions Architect, ISV, AGS ISV
descriptionHtml:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and architecture guidance. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

The Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect team partners with customers to design and build some of the most scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures and solutions. AWS Solutions Architects collaborate with AWS Sales and other AWS teams to help address customer business challenges and accelerate the adoption of AWS services.

As a trusted customer advocate, Solutions Architects help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and provide advice on strategies for migrating existing workloads to the cloud. You’ll help drive successful business outcomes across a broad set of enterprise customers through your passion for educating, training, designing and building cloud solutions.
You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build deep adoption and broad use of AWS within your enterprise customers, and you will do this by mobilizing resources within AWS and working with our extensive partner network.

Key job responsibilities
- Participate in deep architectural and design discussions to create world-class solutions built on AWS while ensuring solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud.
- Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates.
- Author and contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers and proof of concepts.
- In partnership with the sales team, formulate and execute a sales strategy to exceed revenue objectives through the adoption of AWS.
- Design and implement generative AI architectures that orchestrate complex workflows across enterprise systems, leveraging AWS services like Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, and Amazon Q
- Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community.
- Develop strategic technical roadmaps and implementation plans for generative AI solutions that align with customers’ business objectives and existing architecture
- Travel is expected to be 20%.


About the team
Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

Preferred qualifications

title: Sr. HR Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The Senior HR Business Partner (Sr. HRBP) is a key strategic partner on the (Insert Line of Business) PXT team, bringing expertise in leadership development, employee experience, culture, and change management. This role balances tactical excellence with strategic insight, leveraging both technology and human judgment to align local leadership, centralized support, and systems in delivering high-quality employee experiences.

The Sr. HRBP contributes to excellence in PXT service delivery through leadership and strategic insight. They support team development and process optimization while upholding high standards and risk management practices. Leveraging data and experience, they inform business decisions and help implement scalable solutions. Their influence extends across the organization, collaborating with leaders to advance key initiatives and deliver solutions that balance immediate needs with long-term objectives.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility.

Key Responsibilities:

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and develop a diverse team of HR professionals, coaching them to elevate beyond tactical execution to become strategic partners who proactively identify and mitigate organizational risks while delivering exceptional service.

- Drive a culture of proactive risk identification and mitigation by establishing early warning systems, leveraging data insights, and building strong partnerships across functions. Guide your team in developing sound judgment to spot emerging people-related risks before they impact the business.

- Shape the strategic vision for employee experience and organizational health. Challenge status quo thinking and drive innovation in HR practices while ensuring sustainable execution. Enable your team to move beyond immediate problem-solving to address systemic issues and opportunities.

- Partner with business leadership to develop and execute integrated talent strategies that address both current needs and future capability requirements. Coach leaders on effective talent development while building a strong succession pipeline within your own HR organization. Anticipate future talent needs and evolving workforce dynamics to future-proof both operations and HR.

- Lead your team in effective use of analytics and AI tools to uncover hidden patterns, predict emerging risks, and drive data-informed decision making. Translate complex insights into compelling narratives that influence senior stakeholders and drive organizational change.

- Set clear goals for culture transformation with business leaders. Design and implement comprehensive strategies to systematically strengthen organizational health, talent capabilities, and leadership effectiveness. Champion initiatives that measurably enhance diversity, equity and inclusion.

- Drive strategic adoption of HR technology to enable both efficiency and excellence in service delivery. Guide your team to leverage automation while preserving high-touch support for sensitive employee matters requiring human judgment and empathy.

A day in the life
A typical day involves balancing strategic insight with tactical execution. You'll provide expertise in employee relations, coach leaders through performance and development matters, and drive HR functional excellence. Operating with autonomy, you'll partner with leaders at multiple levels to develop forward-looking strategies focused on employee experience and operational objectives.

Through data analytics and AI-enabled tools, you'll identify trends and opportunities while maintaining the human connections essential for building trust. You'll support critical HR processes such as investigations and talent management while leveraging technology to enhance service delivery and decision-making, knowing when automation creates efficiency and when personal interaction remains crucial.

Success in this role comes from effectively enabling strong people leadership, influencing at scale, and addressing root causes of systemic issues. Through a combination of data-driven insights and strategic partnerships, you'll help create and maintain a workplace culture where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to perform at their best.

About the team
Amazon’s Fulfillment Centers (FCs) within North American Customer Fulfillment (NACF) are fast-paced environments that utilize robotics, scanning machines, and computer systems that track and allow the delivery of millions of items (and smiles) to households daily.

NACF PXT is a talent cultivator where Amazonians gain a depth of experience and expertise nurtured to grow, flourish and thrive in other business lines across Amazon. Our HR Leaders provide strategic and tactical leadership direction, executing our people initiatives, providing internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement in locations with up to 6,000 associates. NACF's PXT teams are flexible, thoughtful, socially responsible, and are always planning for the future.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- 5+ years of human resources experience or a mix of equivalent experiences (e.g., operations, customer service, retail, distribution, shipping/logistics, healthcare, hospitality, manufacturing).
- Experience using data and high-judgement to drive business decisions
- Experience supporting and/or leading employee-focused processes such as onboarding, benefits, investigations, training and/or talent management

- Experience resolving sensitive employee relations issues

- Experience leveraging AI-powered tools and technologies to improve processes and service delivery, with demonstrated ability to drive technology adoption amongst teams

title: Software Development Manager, AWS Just Walk Out
descriptionHtml:
As part of the AWS Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Just Walk Out builds technology enables a new kind of stores with no lines and no checkout—you just grab and go! Customers simply use the Amazon Go app to enter the store, take what they want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and go!

Our checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by our Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects when products are taken from or returned to the shelves and keeps track of them in a virtual cart. When you’re done shopping, you can just leave the store. Shortly after, we’ll charge your Amazon account and send you a receipt. Our Just Walk Out Technology uses a variety of technologies including vision, sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning. Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earths’ most customer centric company and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in vision, machine learning, distributed systems and hardware.

As a Software Development Manager, you will own delivery of cross functional initiatives to build new features and improve Just Walk Out experience. You will manage a team of 6-10 software development engineers to build and enhance the shopping experience in Just Walk out stores.

Key job responsibilities
We are looking for an individual that thrives by creating high-bar engineering culture. You’ll be chartered with building software that deliver critical capabilities to our AWS Just Walk out business enabling bar raising customer experience, embed operational knowledge and encode best practices into everything we do.
We have a team culture that encourages innovation and we expect team members and management alike to take high degree of ownership for their program vision and execution of ideas. Beyond a strong engineering, data storage/modeling, visualization, and front-end background, a successful candidate will have experience successfully leading teams, developing people, and building a scalable infrastructure. We are looking for someone that is a self-starter, someone that approaches complex business questions with data and curiosity, and a person that dives below the surface to identify the root cause and "so what" rather than just superficial trends

About the team
Just Walk Out (JWO) is an AWS technology that eliminates checkout lines using computer vision, sensors, & AI. JWO operates across multiple countries, spanning stadiums, airports, college campuses, & Amazon fulfillment centers. We run multiple business models - including vision-based stores & RFID checkout - & we're growing fast. As we scale into new markets & verticals, we're deploying LLMs for shopper support, building AI agents that can operate autonomously, & re-architecting our platform to serve multiple businesses across countries with varying tax, privacy, & regulatory requirements.

Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications & skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive & broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing & never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products & services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity & connection. Our employee-led & company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion & empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, & passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, & other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Stagiaire Partenaire Ressources Humaines Opérations (6 Mois) - 2027
descriptionHtml:
Résumé du poste

L’énergie qui fait tourner le monde | Découvrez les carrières dans les Opérations

Les postes dans les Opérations chez Amazon vous placent au cœur de la façon dont les choses circulent, d’un simple clic jusqu’à la porte du client.
Vous contribuerez à concevoir, améliorer et faire fonctionner des systèmes qui relient les personnes, les produits et les lieux, à grande échelle. Vous prendrez des responsabilités dès le début, travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes pour résoudre des défis concrets, et verrez les résultats directs de vos décisions lorsqu’elles atteignent les clients chaque jour.
Ici, l’impact de ce que vous construisez n’est pas abstrait : il est visible, immédiat et significatif — il maintient en mouvement l’une des opérations les plus complexes au monde.
C’est ici que votre parcours prend forme, à travers l’action, la responsabilité et la possibilité d’évoluer dans de multiples directions.


Key job responsibilities
Principales responsabilités du poste

- Développer une connaissance approfondie des fonctions RH au sein des opérations dynamiques d’Amazon
- Participer aux efforts de communication interne afin d’aligner les équipes de plusieurs pays, en favorisant la collaboration et le partage d’informations
- Aider à élaborer des plans et des supports de formation répondant aux besoins de développement évolutifs des différentes équipes, afin de soutenir la croissance des collaborateurs et collaboratrices
- Découvrir les fonctions RH au sein de l’organisation Amazon au sens large et se tenir informé(e) des meilleures pratiques
- Apporter un soutien aux employé(e)s d’Amazon sur diverses questions quotidiennes liées à la présence, à l’engagement, à la rémunération et à d’autres sujets RH
- Assister les équipes RH dans les routines opérationnelles quotidiennes et les tâches administratives
- Participer à des revues de processus afin d’identifier des opportunités de simplification et d’automatisation, en améliorant l’efficacité
- Compiler des statistiques du personnel, des rapports et des évaluations de performance complets afin d’éclairer la prise de décision
- Collaborer étroitement avec les responsables opérationnel(le)s afin d’aligner les stratégies et initiatives RH sur les objectifs et priorités de l’organisation


A day in the life
Une journée type

Chaque journée est un peu différente en tant que Stagiaire Partenaire Ressources Humaines Opérations. Ce stage vous plongera dans les RH au sein d’une organisation mondiale, avec la possibilité de travailler sur des projets couvrant différents domaines RH — des relations sociales et de la formation à la rémunération et à l’analyse des effectifs. Vous pourriez passer votre matinée à analyser des données sur les effectifs afin d’identifier des tendances et de formuler des recommandations pour votre équipe, puis votre après-midi à accompagner un dossier de relations sociales ou à collaborer avec des responsables opérationnel(le)s sur une initiative de formation.
La fonction RH d’Amazon est profondément intégrée à l’activité ; ainsi, quel que soit le projet sur lequel vous travaillez, une partie de votre rôle consistera à utiliser les données et la réflexion analytique pour orienter les décisions. Vous appliquerez vos compétences en résolution de problèmes et vos compétences techniques à des défis concrets, tout en développant d’importantes compétences en communication et des compétences comportementales professionnelles grâce à une expérience pratique. Avec un(e) mentor(e) dédié(e) qui accompagnera votre développement tout au long du programme, vous découvrirez comment les RH s’associent à l’activité pour stimuler la croissance et l’excellence organisationnelle — offrant une base solide pour une carrière dans les ressources humaines.
Remarque : vous devez avoir le droit de travailler dans le pays d’emploi à la date de début.


About the team
À propos de l’équipe

Communauté des stagiaires :
En tant que stagiaire Amazon, vous ferez partie d’une communauté dynamique et bienveillante qui favorise votre croissance et votre développement. Vous collaborerez avec des stagiaires du monde entier, développerez votre réseau et participerez à des événements sociaux pour élargir vos perspectives. Vous pourrez également rejoindre des groupes spécialisés axés sur des thèmes tels que la durabilité, afin d’explorer vos centres d’intérêt variés.

Accompagnement :
Le programme de stage offre un solide dispositif d’accompagnement, comprenant des permanences hebdomadaires pour les stagiaires, un support informatique et RH dédié, ainsi qu’une équipe programme engagée dans votre réussite. Cela vous garantit l’encadrement et l’aide nécessaires pour vous épanouir.

Sessions d’apprentissage :
Des sessions d’apprentissage exclusives développeront encore vos compétences, en vous donnant accès aux plateformes d’apprentissage de pointe d’Amazon et à l’expertise de leaders du secteur. Ces opportunités de développement structurées vous prépareront à l’étape suivante de votre carrière.

Opportunités :
À l’issue réussie du stage, vous pourrez être considéré(e) pour un poste de jeune diplômé(e) ou un second stage, vous permettant de poursuivre votre parcours avec Amazon. De plus, vous bénéficierez d’un salaire mensuel compétitif, d’un soutien à la relocalisation et d’un accès à une gamme d’avantages réservés aux employés.

Dates de début des stages tout au long de l’année :
Nous recrutons des stagiaires pour un début à tout moment entre janvier et septembre 2027. Chaque mois, nous organiserons 1 à 2 journées d’intégration pour les nouveaux et nouvelles arrivant(e)s.

- Actuellement en dernière année et préparant une licence ou un master universitaire en RH, administration des affaires, psychologie, marketing, sciences sociales, droit ou dans un domaine connexe (à orientation sciences humaines), ou dans une discipline similaire
- Disponible pour un stage à temps plein (35 heures/semaine) et s'engager sur un stage de 6 mois
- Parler, écrire et lire couramment l'anglais et le français à un niveau C1 ou supérieur
- Obligatoire de pouvoir signer une convention de stage avec l'université de l'étudiant(e)

Preferred qualifications

- Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et en analyse, avec la capacité d'utiliser les données pour orienter les décisions
- Excellentes compétences en communication et en travail d'équipe, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement avec diverses parties prenantes
- Curiosité, proactivité et volonté avérées d'apprendre et de se développer dans un environnement dynamique

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. title: Senior Global Engineering Program Manager – Building Controls & Automation, GREF – Design, Sustainability & Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Real Estate and Facilities (GREF) team is seeking an innovative and experienced Sr Global Engineering Program Manager – Building Controls & Automation to lead the technical strategy, standards, and optimization of mechanical and Building Management Systems (BMS)/Controls across our global corporate office portfolio. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for a mechanical or controls engineering specialist. You will own the mechanical and building automation backbone (HVAC, central plant, BMS/BAS, sequences of operation, fault detection) for the global GREF portfolio, while partnering across the broader MEP disciplines.

The ideal candidate combines deep, demonstrable expertise in mechanical systems and building controls with strong leadership and strategic thinking. You are fluent in the language of open-protocol building automation — BACnet, Modbus, Niagara/Tridium — and you can read a sequence of operations, interrogate a controls submittal, and diagnose why a system is not performing. You will develop and execute global engineering initiatives that enhance workplace environments, improve operational efficiency, and advance sustainability goals, navigating complex stakeholder relationships and making data-driven decisions that balance innovation with cost-effectiveness at a global scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Standards & specifications — Develop and maintain global controls/BMS and mechanical design standards, guidelines, and specifications — including sequences of operation, points lists, and naming/tagging conventions — for new construction and retrofits.
- Automation architecture — Define open-protocol BMS architecture (BACnet/IP, BACnet MS/TP, Modbus, Niagara/FOX, MQTT), network topology, and integration; partner with InfoSec and IT on OT network security and data governance.
- Operations & maintenance — Lead operational guidelines and SOPs for mechanical systems, controls, and equipment.
- Performance & FDD — Establish fault detection & diagnostics, trending, and analytics to drive optimization and energy efficiency across the portfolio.
- Technical leadership — Provide SME support to regional teams on complex mechanical and controls issues, including commissioning, Test and Balance (TAB), and root-cause failure analysis.
- Lifecycle & modernization — Develop strategies for equipment lifecycle management, preventive maintenance, and system modernization.
- Sustainability — Advance corporate environmental goals through mechanical and BMS initiatives.
- Technology & innovation — Evaluate and recommend new building systems, controls, and smart-building technologies.
- Metrics & vendors — Set KPIs and track portfolio improvements; partner with procurement on equipment/controls-vendor standards, qualification, and performance.
- Strategy & growth — Support due diligence for acquisitions and renovations, deliver technical training, and shape long-term strategy and capital planning.

About the team
The GREF Global Engineering team drives continuous improvement for mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems across Amazon's corporate office portfolio worldwide. We set design and construction standards, develop operations and maintenance guidelines, and shape long-term MEP strategy — balancing innovation, sustainability, and cost-effectiveness at global scale. Our team thrives on diverse expertise, cross-functional collaboration, and data-driven decision-making to deliver resilient, high-performing workplaces. We're looking for technical leaders who challenge the status quo and bring fresh perspectives to complex building system challenges.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- 6+ years of experience in building systems engineering

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in data analysis, with the ability to interpret and draw insights from data to inform decision-making processes
- Professional Engineering (PE) license
- Certifications such as LEED, PMP, CEM, and/or HBDP.
- Deep hands-on experience with BMS/BAS platforms and open protocols — Tridium/Niagara (FOX), BACnet, Modbus — including programming, commissioning, and integration.
- Experience with fault detection & diagnostics (FDD) and building analytics platforms (e.g., SkySpark) and using building data to drive optimization.
- Experience with OT network architecture and building-systems cybersecurity/InfoSec coordination.
- Experience directly related to the design or construction of commercial office buildings.
- Experience managing engineering programs for large, global real estate portfolios.
- International project experience.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

title: System Development Engineer, Antenna Calibration, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

As an Antenna Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for key aspects of phased array antenna system design, simulation, measurement, calibration and optimization. You will be working in a collaborative environment with a multi-disciplinary team to deliver advanced high-performance phased array antenna systems. In this role, your responsibilities will include:
· Designing and implementing phased array calibration systems, signals, processing and algorithms
· Performance analysis and design trade-off studies of phased arrays
· End-to-end modeling, simulation and analysis of baseband/RF/antenna systems
· Lab measurement and validation of performance of antennas, and phased array systems and subsystems
· Working with antenna, modem, RF and Digital teams to simulate, measure and fine-tune radio designs

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be U.S. citizens, U.S. permanent residents (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop novel calibration algorithms and techniques for complex phased array antenna systems, including element-level amplitude and phase correction, to ensure optimal beam-forming performance across all operating conditions.
- Perform end-to-end over-the-air (OTA) validation of phased array antenna systems, including beam pattern verification, EIRP, EVM, and sensitivity measurements, ensuring compliance with system-level specifications.
- Support factory production at scale by developing robust, repeatable calibration and test processes, troubleshooting yield issues, and driving continuous improvement to maintain throughput and quality on the production floor.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including antenna design, ASIC, software, and systems engineering — to debug and root-cause issues impacting phased array antenna performance, driving resolution from identification through implementation.
- Design, maintain, and operate CICD (compact indoor chamber/direct) test chambers, including calibration schedules, reference device tracking, and measurement uncertainty documentation.
- Develop and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts for antenna characterization and calibration workflows, improving efficiency and repeatability of measurement processes.
- Generate and maintain technical reports, test procedures, and calibration documentation to support design reviews, certification, and production readiness milestones.
- Analyze antenna measurement data — including beam patterns, sidelobe levels, null depths, and polarization purity — to identify performance trends, anomalies, and root causes across development and production units.

- Experience with Linux/Unix
- Experience with RF measurement equipment, including: power meters, spectrum analyzers, vector signal generators, network analyzers, oscilloscopes
- Experience with coding/scripting in one or more languages (e.g., Python, C, C++, Java, Ruby, or PowerShell)
- BS in Electrical Engineering with relevant coursework in digital communication theory, digital signal processing, RF/Microwave Engineering, Antennas and Electromagnetic theory
- Experience in DSP techniques, digital modulation, radio architecture, line-up analysis, RF system design
- Experience with simulation tools such as SystemVue, ADS or LabView

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of multiple access systems including OFDMA, TDMA, and CDMA

title: Engineering Operations Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Our inclusion of events fosters stronger, more collaborative teams. Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

You sit at the intersection of alliance management, business development and market development. You will also work closely with AWS's global alliance teams to turn global agreements and investments into local results. Your focus is on creating new pipeline through your partners. You will do this by shaping their go-to-market priorities on cloud migration, modernisation, data and generative AI, building differentiated industry solutions on AWS, and finding new demand in their client base. You will also drive the capability investments that grow their AWS practice, such as certifications, competencies and specialised teams. You can hold a strategic conversation with a GSI country managing partner about market direction and joint investment, then pivot to working with solution architects and partner practice leads on a new offering. You understand how professional services firms run their business: utilisation, practice economics, partner incentives and the alliance landscape across multiple cloud providers. You use that understanding to build compelling joint plans that grow the partner's AWS business and turn into new pipeline and long-term revenue.

You will interface with customer and AWS leadership, driving collaboration between the other core account groups (Sales, Support, Solutions Architecture, and Professional Services), product/engineering teams, and customer teams, planning and supporting major workload migrations and modernizations. You will translate strategic initiatives in the account plan into executable actions, working backwards from our customers key milestones. The execution of education plans, roadmap to business outcome alignments, Executive Briefing Sessions, and technical customer engagements are a few items owned by the CSM that are critical to the success of our customer’s cloud journey.
You are encouraged to think big, invent and take ownership on customer challenges. You will not only bring the best of AWS/Amazon to our customers, you will proactively help solve the customer’s challenges through new ideas, tools and mechanisms.
Successful candidates will have a strong technical background, familiar with agentic AI/GenAI, be aware of details that matter, have excellent problem-solving abilities, and be exemplary communicators both at the executive and project team level. You will evangelize AWS services and influence customers for adopting them. descriptionHtml:
A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. Drive clarity where neither the business problem nor technology approach is fully defined. Build production systems that handle enterprise-scale traffic and reliability requirements.

Own production excellence across workstreams

Establish mechanisms (testing strategies, observability standards, incident response playbooks) that ensure AI systems remain healthy. Drive operational improvements that raise the bar for the team.

Scale the team's effectiveness
- Define engineering patterns, contribute to the interview and hiring process, and mentor junior FDEs into independent contributors. Coach others on system design, customer engagement, and production operations. Drive engineering excellence standards within your scope.

Accelerate customer transformation
- Identify systemic opportunities to expand AI adoption across the customer organization. Create accelerators and reusable platforms that reduce time-to-value from months to weeks. Feed learnings back into AWS services and the FDE practice.

descriptionHtml:

Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. title: Data Center Controls Tech, Controls Team
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

Key job responsibilities
Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.

Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.

Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.

Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.

Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.

Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.

Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.

Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.

Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.

Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.

Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.

Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.

Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.

Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.

Ensure personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.

Perform service activities including monitoring and reviewing ticketing systems, conducting root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.

Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.

Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses.

Perform other tasks as assigned by manager.

As a Data Center Controls Technician, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who rely on you to keep Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS) healthy and operational. On a given day, you are the boots on the ground solving problems that directly impact data center availability. You might diagnose a controller communication loss, calibrate instruments feeding inaccurate data to operators, or supervise vendors performing quarterly maintenance. For new builds, you perform point to point testing and support commissioning alongside construction teams. Your internal stakeholders include your Controls Engineer, Controls Manager, partner teams (Field Engineering, Critical Project Implementation, DCEO), and the vendors you oversee.

title: Transportation Representative
descriptionHtml:
Network Operations Center (NOC) – Overview

The Network Operations Center (NOC) serves as the central command and control hub for Transportation Execution across Amazon's Supply Chain network, spanning multiple geographies including North America, India, and the EU.

NOC is responsible for ensuring the seamless, on-time movement of freight — from vendor pick-ups to Amazon Fulfillment Centers (FCs), and from FCs to carrier hubs. When exceptions arise, NOC takes swift ownership of resolution while keeping all relevant stakeholders informed throughout the process.

Beyond tactical problem-solving, NOC is also entrusted with a strategic mandate: identifying trends in network exceptions, driving process automation, and recommending operational improvements to streamline transportation workflows. This requires continuous network monitoring and in-depth analysis of network data.

In essence, NOC plays a pivotal role in the smooth functioning of Amazon's transportation network — directly influencing Amazon's ability to deliver on its promise to customers.

Role of a Trans Ops Representative

A Trans Ops Representative at NOC acts as a critical link between key stakeholders — including Transportation Carriers, Hubs, and Warehouses — facilitating the flow of information and resolving issues that could impact customer experience or business continuity. The role spans two core verticals:

Inbound Operations – Manages the Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring freight is picked up on time and delivered to FCs as per scheduled appointments. The Trans Ops Representative addresses any issues arising during the pick-up to delivery lifecycle.
Outbound Operations – Manages the FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring trucks depart FCs on schedule to fulfill customer delivery promises. The Trans Ops Representative addresses any issues from the point freight leaves the FC through to last-mile delivery.
Trans Ops Representatives drive real-time resolutions by leveraging internal tools, querying relevant data, and making informed, time-sensitive decisions. The ideal candidate brings a solid understanding of logistics operations, a sharp eye for data trends, and the ability to communicate effectively — both verbally and in writing.

Key job responsibilities
Trans Ops Representatives are expected to proactively identify opportunities for process improvement and drive them to completion. Core responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Serving as the communication bridge between external stakeholders (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal stakeholders (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
Systematically escalating issues or data variances to the appropriate owners and teams, and following through to ensure timely resolution
Preparing and presenting weekly narratives that outline key findings and variances against goals in review forums
Delivering real-time customer experience support within a 24×7 operating environment

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in any discipline
- 12–24 months of relevant work experience
- Strong communication skills — both verbal and written — with the ability to facilitate seamless information flow between external and internal stakeholders
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables and VLOOKUPs
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively within a team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree with strong academic foundation
- Sound logical and analytical thinking skills
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to coordinate across multiple cross-functional teams

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Sponsored Products and Brands Off-Search
descriptionHtml:
The Sponsored Products and Brands (SPB) team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through state-of-the-art generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.

Key job responsibilities
This role will be pivotal in redesigning how ads contribute to a personalized, relevant, and inspirational shopping experience, with the customer value proposition at the forefront. Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Contribute to the design and development of GenAI, deep learning, multi-objective optimization and/or reinforcement learning empowered solutions to transform ad retrieval, auctions, whole-page relevance, and/or bespoke shopping experiences.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with other scientists, engineers, and product managers to bring scalable, production-ready science solutions to life.
- Stay abreast of industry trends in GenAI, LLMs, and related disciplines, bringing fresh and innovative concepts, ideas, and prototypes to the organization.
- Contribute to the enhancement of team’s scientific and technical rigor by identifying and implementing best-in-class algorithms, methodologies, and infrastructure that enable rapid experimentation and scaling.
- Mentor and grow junior scientists and engineers, cultivating a high-performing, collaborative, and intellectually curious team.

A day in the life
As an Applied Scientist on the Sponsored Products and Brands Off-Search team, you will contribute to the development in Generative AI (GenAI) and Large Language Models (LLMs) to revolutionize our advertising flow, backend optimization, and frontend shopping experiences. This is a rare opportunity to redefine how ads are retrieved, allocated, and/or experienced—elevating them into personalized, contextually aware, and inspiring components of the customer journey. You will have the opportunity to fundamentally transform areas such as ad retrieval, ad allocation, whole-page relevance, and differentiated recommendations through the lens of GenAI. By building novel generative models grounded in both Amazon’s rich data and the world’s collective knowledge, your work will shape how customers engage with ads, discover products, and make purchasing decisions. If you are passionate about applying frontier AI to real-world problems with massive scale and impact, this is your opportunity to define the next chapter of advertising science.

About the team
The Off-Search team within Sponsored Products and Brands (SPB) is focused on building delightful ad experiences across various surfaces beyond Search on Amazon—such as product detail pages, the homepage, and store-in-store pages—to drive monetization. Our vision is to deliver highly personalized, context-aware advertising that adapts to individual shopper preferences, scales across diverse page types, remains relevant to seasonal and event-driven moments, and integrates seamlessly with organic recommendations such as new arrivals, basket-building content, and fast-delivery options. To execute this vision, we work in close partnership with Amazon Stores stakeholders to lead the expansion and growth of advertising across Amazon-owned and -operated pages beyond Search. We operate full stack—from backend ads-retail edge services, ads retrieval, and ad auctions to shopper-facing experiences—all designed to deliver meaningful value.

Curious about our advertising solutions? Discover more about Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands to see how we’re helping businesses grow on Amazon.com and beyond!

- Experience developing and deploying models in real-world production environments.

title: Head of Defence Solution Architecture, ANZ Worldwide Public Sector
descriptionHtml:
Do you have deep experience working with Australian Defence customers, and the cloud expertise to match? AWS is looking for a leader to head our Defence Solutions Architecture team in Australia — someone who understands how Defence operates, the environment it works within, and how cloud technology can genuinely advance mission outcomes.

We're looking for someone with broad familiarity across the Australian Defence Organisation and the Defence Industrial Base, and a genuine interest in the Defence mission — whether that experience was gained inside Defence or working adjacent to it (for example, in consulting, systems integration, defence industry, or a technology provider serving Defence customers). In this role, you will lead a team of senior AWS solutions architects who partner with customers across the Defence sector to design and implement cloud-based systems that meet some of the most demanding security and compliance requirements in the industry. This is a player-coach position — you will guide your team's engagements while also working directly with customers when your expertise can drive the greatest impact.

Applicants must be Australian citizens and must hold or be able to attain an Australian Government Security Vetting Agency clearance (see https://www1.defence.gov.au/security/clearances).

Above all, this is a people-leadership role. You will build, grow, and develop a high-performing team of solutions architects — hiring and retaining strong talent, coaching your people through complex engagements, and creating an environment where they can do their best work. Australia's strategic circumstances have fundamentally shifted, and Defence is modernising at pace. Success in this role depends on genuine credibility across the Defence community — the ability to earn trust with senior Defence leaders, understand their mission and operational challenges, and translate those challenges into secure, compliant, cloud-enabled solutions. You will set the strategic direction for your organisation, prioritise where AWS invests its time for maximum customer outcomes, and build a team culture grounded in technical excellence and deep customer understanding.

A working knowledge of Australian Government security policy, including the Essential Eight and the Information Security Registered Assessors Program (IRAP), is essential. If you are ready to lead where cloud technology meets Defence, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Build, grow, and develop a high-performing team of senior solutions architects — hiring and retaining strong talent, actively coaching and mentoring your people, and investing in their career growth.

You start your morning reviewing key metrics and customer engagement updates from your leadership team. After lunch, you lead a talent review discussion, identifying development opportunities for emerging leaders across your organisation. Later, you connect with cross-functional partners to align on an upcoming product launch, ensuring your team's roadmap supports shared objectives.

Our team works with Australian Defence customers to help them adopt and build on AWS with confidence. We partner closely with account teams, security specialists, and service teams to deliver solutions that meet the highest standards of compliance and performance.

title: Cellular Systems Engineering Lead, Direct-to-Device, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is building a Low Earth Orbit satellite constellation designed to provide connectivity to customers around the world.

We are looking for an experienced cellular systems engineering lead with end-to-end experience across the radio access network (RAN), the 5G core, and commercial devices for direct-to-device (D2D) services. This role covers the complete cellular side of the service, everything except the satellite itself, and connects it into one working system.

The ideal candidate has worked on real D2D, NTN, satellite-to-cellular, or closely related systems, with deep RAN expertise, solid 5G core knowledge, and hands-on device experience. We are looking for someone who understands how RAN, core, and devices behave together end to end, can work directly with RAN, core, and chipset and device vendors, and can find and resolve issues that cross those boundaries.


The successful candidate will combine broad cellular and service knowledge with strong customer and partner skills, strong ownership, and the ability to lead in a fast-moving, international environment.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the cellular system view of the D2D service across RAN, 5G core, and devices, including requirements, interfaces, and end-to-end behavior.
• Define and review RAN system requirements for NTN operation, including scheduling, HARQ, timing advance, mobility, and access control.
• Define and review 5G core requirements and interfaces (including interworking with terrestrial networks, QoS and policy, and charging), and their interaction with the RAN.
• Own device-side system requirements and behavior, including 3GPP NTN feature support, UE requirements, mobility between terrestrial and satellite networks, and device-side connection management.
• Work directly with RAN, core, chipset, and device vendors to resolve end-to-end issues, from protocol analysis to root cause and fix.
• Support end-to-end integration and interoperability activities across RAN, core, and devices, in the lab, in RF chambers, and over the air.
• Analyze end-to-end call flows and performance (attach, registration, sessions, handover, voice, messaging, data) and translate findings into requirements and design recommendations.
• Track 3GPP NTN standards evolution and assess its impact on the RAN, core, and device roadmap.
• Act as the subject matter expert for RAN, core, and device systems, and work closely with System Architecture, Systems Engineering, Integration and Test, and Telco Service Development.
• Work effectively across geographically distributed, international and multicultural engineering and partner organizations.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a related field
- 8+ years of professional experience in cellular systems, including at least 3 years in the Direct-to-Device (D2D) ecosystem, NTN, or direct satellite-to-cellular connectivity.
- Deep experience with 4G or 5G RAN systems, protocols, and procedures (L1 to L3).
- Solid working knowledge of the 5G core architecture and interfaces, including interworking with terrestrial networks
- Experience with commercial devices or chipsets, including device logs and analytics tools, in support of cellular or D2D services.
- Working knowledge of 3GPP NTN standards
- Experience resolving end-to-end issues with RAN, core, and device vendors.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with satellite-based RAN architectures for NTN.
- Experience with voice over NR (VoNR/IMS), messaging, and emergency services.
- Experience with device interoperability testing and certification programs.
- Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to work effectively across engineering teams, vendors, partners, and leadership organizations.

title: Software Development Engineer, Network Monitoring and Remediation (NMR)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's network carries traffic for hundreds of millions of customers, and the Network Monitoring and Remediation (NMR) team keeps it healthy. As a Software Development Engineer II on NMR, you will build streaming data pipelines, automated remediation services, and diagnostic tooling that detect and resolve network impairments before customers ever notice. You will work across the full software development lifecycle, turning ambiguous problems into well-designed, maintainable solutions. If you are a collaborative engineer who enjoys solving hard distributed-systems problems and mentoring teammates along the way, this is a role where your code has real, measurable impact every single day.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build streaming data pipelines that ingest network telemetry at scale, and develop the automated remediation services that act on those signals in real time.
- Create and improve diagnostic tooling that helps network operators quickly identify and resolve the issues automation has not yet addressed.
- Participate actively in code reviews, provide constructive feedback to teammates, and mentor other engineers on writing well-documented, reliable software.
- Collaborate with network engineers, data scientists, and product partners to translate operational needs into clear system designs and working solutions.
- Identify root causes of operational issues, drive improvements to your team's technical processes, and evaluate new tools and approaches, including generative AI, to raise productivity and code quality.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing operational metrics and triaging any alerts from overnight deployments. From there you might write and test code for a new remediation workflow, then join a design discussion where you and your teammates sketch out approaches to an ambiguous detection problem. Later you could pair with a network engineer to validate telemetry signals or review a pull request from a newer team member. Your work blends deep technical problem-solving with regular collaboration across engineering and operations.

About the team
Network Monitoring and Remediation (NMR) prevents, predicts, detects, and remediates network impairments before they reach customers. Our systems ingest trillions of telemetry data points daily from millions of network devices, apply streaming analytics and ML/AI to surface actionable signals, and drive automated mitigation through our event management platform. Today, over 98% of detected issues are resolved without human intervention. Our vision is a future where every network failure is pre-emptively resolved by autonomous systems, with zero customer impact.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
