title: Software Development Engineer - Lambda, AWS Lambda Control Plane
descriptionHtml:
Software Development Engineer — AWS Lambda Control Plane (Dublin)

When millions of builders ship their Lambda functions, it all just works — in seconds, anywhere in the world. The machinery that makes that possible is the control plane: the systems that validate, orchestrate, and propagate every function's state so the data plane can execute it flawlessly at any scale.

As part of the team you'll design, build, and operate the distributed systems that sit between customers and the Lambda data plane:

You'll own the full path from API request to running function. The APIs you build are the public surface of Lambda — high-throughput, strictly consistent, globally available — serving customers and CloudFormation alike. Behind those APIs, you'll design the asynchronous workflows that orchestrate a function's lifecycle: taking a customer's intent — a new function, a code deploy, a version publish — and propagating it safely to the systems that actually execute functions. That means solving metadata propagation at global scale: ensuring every configuration change reaches the right compute fleet, in the right region, with the right ordering guarantees, even under partial failures.

We operate at the scale of one of the largest services in AWS. Availability is a first-class design constraint, not an afterthought.

What we're looking for

- Experience designing and operating distributed systems in production — the kind where "retry" isn't a strategy, it's a starting point.
- Comfort with ambiguity: you'll own problems end-to-end, from API contract through data-plane handoff.
- Strong fundamentals in at least one of: Java, Python, or TypeScript (our stack spans all three).
- A bias toward simple, operable solutions — systems that are easy to reason about at 3 AM.

About the team
We're a Dublin-based engineering team within AWS Lambda. We invest in growing engineers through meaningful ownership, direct mentorship, and exposure to problems that don't have textbook answers. We value diverse perspectives and hire for collaboration — the best systems here are built by teams, not individuals.

Basic qualifications

- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

- Experience with network hardware: copper and optical fiber cabling, switches, routers

title: Supply Chain Manager II, Amazon Grocery Logistics
descriptionHtml:
The Japan Perishable Supply Chain (PSC) team is looking for a talented Supply Chain Manager who excels in hypothetical thinking and data driven decision making. In this position, you will play an instrumental role in delivering optimal capacity management as our Grocery business grows and scales across Japan.
You will be part of a team dedicated to quality, customer experience, and efficiency; supporting 1P and 3P operations with stakeholders both domestically here in Japan, as well as Worldwide Grocery. Your primary deliverable will be Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), which is a short/mid-term volume planning. S&OP is a critical business/operation elements, which forecasts upcoming shipment/arrival volume based on diving deep into multiple historical data points, and driving discussion and alignment with multiple stakeholders. You will need to execute optimal forecast planning considering business growth and capacity constraint across storage space in warehouse to labor resources.
Additionally, you will support with transportation network design, working collaboratively to deliver the right capacity and cost to enable overall profitability.
Your S&OP responsibilities will be a continuous activity, where uncertainty in new and growing business lines will require you to remain agile. Your decisions will have network wide impact, driving cost efficiency and supporting capacity across our Japan Grocery operations. Furthermore, in order to realize an optimal inventory plan that enables maximizing business growth under capacity constraints, the optimization of inbound flow from vendors/other warehouses is also an important mission in the role; and allowing you to partner within our Core and Logistics operations.
In addition, it is also expected that best practices will be found in cooperation with overseas teams for S&OP planning/methodology and inbound flow. You will contribute efficient process design as internet supermarket in worldwide. Even in an ambiguous environment, the role is expected to have the ability to think strategically and tactically, handle multiple priorities and make decisions for optimal capacity planning in view of business growth and costs.


Key job responsibilities
• Operate the volume planning for the Distribution and Fulfillment Centers with weekly cadence.
• Create a plan of the 7-21 day and 13-week horizon by managing inputs from business plans, operational constraints, and labor plans; and maintain all outputs accurate and updated.
• Support 1P and 3P business and operations team on planning and S&OP accuracy
• With giving detailed insight into variances versus planned volumes, execute countermeasures to resolve the variances, and also continuously improve forecasting accuracy.
• Realize the optimal inventory volume and arrival form and then optimize the workload in FC operations.
Reduce operation cost by analyzing data and the drivers of forecast misses/opportunities to provide optimized operation.
• Collaborate with Supply Chain and Tech teams in North America and Continental EU & United Kingdom to establish best practices, implement new tools/systems, and build end to end operation processes for the growth of the business.
• Projects ownership related to supply chain and forecasting accuracy improvement in collaboration with business and operations teams.


About the team
Perishable Grocery is an important growth area for Amazon, and our team is a critical component to deliver this growth in Japan. We support the overall supply chain, inclusive of transportation, third party external fulfillment service management, operations planning, and more - without which we could not deliver the quality and freshness of product needed to earn the trust of our customers.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of supply chain experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Business-level Japanese & English language proficiency in reading, writing, and meetings

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- 3+ years of data visualization and reports tools experience

Amazonでは、優れた実績と確実なプロジェクトマネジメント経験を持ち、複数の事業領域にまたがる戦略的・戦術的・部門横断的・テクノロジー関連のプロジェクトおよびプログラムを推進できるプログラムマネージャーを募集しています。本ポジションでは、プロジェクト計画のスコーピングと策定、プロセスの構築、実行の調整・推進、およびシニアマネジメントへの進捗・リスク・プロセスやプロダクトの変更に関する報告を担っていただきます。チーム間での協働、プロジェクトマネジメント力、経営層向けプレゼンテーションスキルが不可欠になります。豊富なプロジェクトマネジメント経験に加え、高い分析力と鋭いイノベーション感覚を活かし、複雑なプロジェクトを構想段階から完遂まで推進いただける方を求めています。 本ポジションでは特にサプライチェーンおよび輸送ネットワークの構築・改善を効果的に管理いただけるプログラムマネージャーを募集しています。主な業務としては大規模プロジェクトのスコーピング、プロジェクトタイムラインの管理、および進捗・リスク・ビジネス課題を共有するための仕組みの構築を行っていただきます。前述の通り、チーム間の協働力、プロジェクトマネジメント力、データ分析力に長け、成果を出してきた実績をお持ちの方を求めています。 Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。 AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
• Supply chain, transportation, or logistic network management solution experience

主な職務内容：
• サプライチェーン、輸送、またはロジスティクスネットワークの管理・改善経験を有すること

A day in the life

Drive execution discipline in operations across various stakeholders, including Global Logistics, Asia Pacific Operations, Retail and FBA, US Fulfillment Centers, Procurement, Finance, Compliance, and Legal.

About the team
Global Logistics (GL) is a dynamic team of seasoned logistics professionals, carrier specialists, and program managers dedicated to enhancing Amazon's cross-border logistics. The Asia-Pacific, Japan and Brazil (APJ/BR) team manages import operations across: Japan (JP), Australia (AU) and Brazil (BR) through comprehensive cross-border Business-to-Business programs.

If you are passionate about logistics and supply chain management and have a proven track record of driving operational excellence, we invite you to apply for the Program Manager role at Amazon’s Global Logistics APJ/BR team. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to Amazon’s global growth and make a significant impact on our logistics operations.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. 物流およびサプライチェーンマネジメントに熱意があり、オペレーショナルエクセレンスの推進において実績のある方のご応募をお待ちしております。AmazonのGlobal Logistics APJ/BRチームのプログラムマネージャーとして、Amazonのグローバルな成長に貢献し、物流オペレーションに大きなインパクトを与える機会です。
Amazonでは、社員およびその対象家族（事実婚パートナーとその子どもを含む）を支援する各種福利厚生を提供しています。福利厚生の内容は、勤務地、所定労働時間、勤続期間、雇用形態（季節雇用・有期雇用等）により異なる場合がありますのでご留意ください。

title: Software Dev Engineer, Pricing Shared Platform
descriptionHtml:
Pricing Shared Services team owns the core set of systems which decides prices of products sold by Amazon Retail. The team owns system data vending, notification and price publishing systems which are used by multiple pricing strategy teams for building their price recommendation and submission of their recommended prices. These systems scale to thousands of TPS and computes prices for billions of listing every month. We are building new services that radically scales publishing capacity of our systems while making our services multi-tenant to support Amazon's growing number of businesses. We collaborate with product, science, and business teams to figure out new ideas. We innovate by applying state-of-the-art computer science to define, design, and build our systems. And we experiment with different approaches, eager to learn from whatever the results are while having fun along the way.

To help meet these goals, we are looking for a passionate, talented Software Development Engineer. We are looking for someone who innovates, loves solving hard problems, and looks for 'yes' as the answer. As a Software Development Engineer, you will develop services using your expertise and experience with a variety of technologies. You will deep-dive into distributed systems to design and optimize for performance, maintainability, scalability, and extensibility. You will innovate and scale services, addressing problems that span new feature development to new system creation. You will design and write clean, maintainable code and integrate data from a large number of services. And you will contribute to the development of yourself and colleagues through peer code-reviews and mentoring, improving the technical knowledge and engineering practices of your team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, and operate features that scale and extend the Amazon Store experience on Echo Show and Fire devices.
- Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving thoughtful feedback.
- Contribute to systems that render the Amazon store in real time, keep it in sync, and support conversational, multimodal shopping flows.
- Help extend the experience to new surfaces and international marketplaces, working through ambiguity where there is no existing playbook.
- Own your components end-to-end through livesite operations — monitoring, on-call participation, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance.
- Collaborate with engineering, science, product, and design partners across Alexa Shopping, including teammates in Seattle across time zones.
- Contribute ideas to technical designs, ask good questions, and grow your scope and autonomy over time with support from senior engineers and mentors.

About the team
You'll join Pricing Error Detection (PED), part of Amazon's Pricing Shared Services. Our job is simple to say and hard to do: make sure no customer ever sees a price that's wrong, too low for Amazon to sustain or too high for customers to trust. We review hundreds of millions of price decisions every week, before and after they go live, across Amazon's marketplaces worldwide. To do that, we build LLM-based agents that check prices against live signals from across the web, and machine learning models that judge whether each price makes sense. Together they catch errors, correct them, and stop them from happening again. If you want to put the latest GenAI to work at Amazon scale, where every decision protects both customers and the business, we'd love to talk.

Basic qualifications

-3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
-2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
-Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

-3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
-Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Sr. Tech Infra Program Manager, OIS NANO
descriptionHtml:
Own the network and device technology infrastructure strategy for Amazon's fastest-growing Quick Commerce operation across an entire region. As the single-threaded infrastructure owner, you'll define the technology roadmap, drive vendor relationships, and enable hundreds of sites to launch at unprecedented speed while maintaining enterprise-grade availability and cost optimization.

Key job responsibilities
As a Sr. TIPM with the Network and Assets for Nimble Operations (NANO) Team you will:
- Define country-level infrastructure strategy by establishing architecture standards and readiness criteria that guide all site launches, ensuring consistency and quality across the fleet
- Own end-to-end network infrastructure scope from vendor selection through service level agreement governance to financial outcome management, driving performance and cost efficiency
- Identify and recommend end-user equipment (associate-facing devices such as scanners, workstations, and printers) that meet regional cost and performance targets, partnering with device technology teams for certification
- Establish playbooks, architecture standards, and deployment sequencing for the country, stepping in at escalation points where selections carry fleet-wide implications beyond execution-level authority
- Drive network availability outcomes, device fleet health, and financial performance across the country's fleet through structured vendor governance cadences and performance management

A day in the life
You own the network and device technology infrastructure of Quick Commerce — the fastest growth vector for Amazon Stores. Your day moves between defining regional network strategy that scales from hundreds to thousands of sites, steering technology capability investments toward fleet-scale readiness, evaluating transitions that deliver cost reduction compared to traditional models, and presenting infrastructure roadmaps to senior business operations leadership. You make architecture and vendor selections that determine availability, cost trajectory, and launch velocity for an entire geography.

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
We are the Network and Assets for Nimble Operations (NANO) team within Operations Infrastructure Services. We exist to solve a singular challenge: enabling Amazon Operations to launch and operate thousands of small-footprint sites at speed, at scale, and at a fraction of traditional infrastructure cost. We own the full infrastructure lifecycle — network strategy, vendor contracts, site launches, incident management, and financial governance — across India, United States, Middle East, United Kingdom, and Japan. Quick Commerce dark stores represent the overwhelming majority of our use cases today, scaling from approximately 500 sites to 3,000+ by 2028, with our enablement model extending to every emerging no-capex site type in Amazon's portfolio.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in an IT-related field (e.g., Computer Science, Network Engineering), or experience in computer networking
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience in technical infrastructure management, including data center, network infrastructure, or systems engineering environments
- Experience in program or project management, with a track record of managing end-to-end delivery of infrastructure programs across multiple sites or geographies
- Experience managing vendor relationships, including contract negotiations, service level agreement governance, and performance management
- Experience defining architecture standards, deployment playbooks, or infrastructure readiness criteria for scaled operations

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in a technology field
- Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
- Experience in procurement, inventory and asset management of IT equipment as well as IT lifecycle
- Experience owning program strategy, managing end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience in network engineering, network capacity planning, or systems engineering for distributed site environments (e.g., fulfillment centers, dark stores, quick commerce sites)
- Experience in quick commerce, retail operations, or logistics infrastructure programs at scale
- Experience driving cost optimization or frugality initiatives across infrastructure portfolios

title: Sr. Risk Manager, Finance Operations, Finance Operations Risk, Governance, & Experience
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Senior Risk Manager to support the Finance Operations (FinOps) Controllership team at Amazon. We’re looking for someone who can take lead in understanding complex FinOps processes and identify the full range of risks related to processes, regulatory compliance, organization, policy, and technology. This individual will ensure FinOps processes stay ahead of risks associated with process design, internal control effectiveness, computer system integration, and other relevant areas.
As a Senior Risk Manager on the FORGE team, you won't just find problems, you'll architect solutions. You will lead high-impact audits and risk programs across Finance Operations (FinOps), with a primary focus on Global Real Estate & Facilities. Your work will directly strengthen the control environment, protect Amazon from material risk, and drive the kind of operational excellence that lets Finance scale with confidence.

In this role, you will lead and oversee projects, such as inspections, risk assessments, and advisory services, that shape process and control design to mitigate risk and drive a continuous controllership culture. Responsibilities will also include preparation of findings and engagement with stakeholders to complete action items. Your subject matter expertise is critical to develop strong working knowledge of processes, current initiatives, and organizational changes.

This role requires strong leadership skills to influence others and/or self-serve in order to achieve critical inspection objectives. You will be expected to identify risks in our processes and work with the appropriate owners to mitigate risks. You will need to dive deep to understand Amazon’s disparate and complex processes and related applications and work through ambiguity to deliver results.

Key job responsibilities
Successful candidates must be eager to dive deep into processes and have a proven record of delivering meaningful risks and recommendations to the business. The candidate should have strong auditing skills, problem solving skills, systems and process knowledge, and a passion for customer service. Specific core responsibilities are below:
• Perform risk assessments of the organization
• Perform end to end audits, including scoping, fieldwork, and reporting
• Evaluate design and effectiveness of FinOps controls
• Evaluate policy and process exceptions
• Prepare clear, compelling audit reports, executive narratives, and leadership-ready communications. Present findings, recommendations, and risk trade-offs to senior leaders (Director and above) with precision and confidence
• Provide training that improves and raises the bar on controllership with respect to policies and other requirements
• Support ad hoc inspections, deep dives, and reviews across broader FinOps and upstream business processes as new risks emerge or business needs evolve
• Provide strategic perspective on risk-related business and technology decisions. Help stakeholders see around corners, prioritize the right mitigation investments, and avoid building risk into new processes

A day in the life
• Lead scoping, planning, and execution of complex audits and risk assessments across FinOps processes.
• Own end-to-end lifecycle of high-impact, cross-functional risk programs.
• Identify control gaps, evaluate control effectiveness, and drive sustainable remediation plans.
• Define project objectives, success criteria, and risk reduction metrics.
• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to prioritize risk initiatives, influence decisions, and drive execution.
• Develop data-driven audit reports and executive communications presenting findings and recommendations to senior leadership.
• Influence stakeholders to implement scalable, automated controls and eliminate recurring risks.
• Leverage data, automation, and technology to improve risk detection and audit efficiency.

About the team
Finance Operations Risk, Governance & Experience (FORGE)’s mission is to improve controllership across Finance Operations (FinOps) by identifying risks, protecting assets, designing to-be controls, testing existing controls, and as appropriate, assisting process owners with risk mitigation or remediation. In addition, FORGE collaborates with teams within and beyond FinOps on risk assessments, compliance, corporate social responsibility, regulatory, and governance matters. FORGE also serves as FinOps's program manager for the global external audit, provides controllership support for non-integrated subsidiaries, and is the contact for FinOps owned Internal Audit findings.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or equivalent
- Experience at consulting firms or equivalent
- Experience working across teams and influencing teams that are not your own
- Experience in relevant finance roles, or experience in identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary. As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis. The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

title: Mgr, Post Delivery Ops, PAC
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
The Power & Cooling (PAC) team is seeking a senior leader to build and run the Post-Delivery organization — one of the three pillars of PAC Supply Chain Operations — accountable for getting every piece of Long Lead Equipment (LLE) from delivery through successful, on-time Power Facilities Hand Off (PFHO) at the scale AWS now builds. This is a broad, high-visibility leadership role: you will stand up a brand-new organization, lead leaders, set multi-year strategy, and own the outcome that gates every data center going live. The successful candidate is an experienced people leader who can operate at the strategic level with executives and across functions, while building the team, the mechanisms, and the culture that make on-time PFHO repeatable.
As the leader of the Power and Cooling Post-Delivery organization, you will build and manage a team across multiple areas — across Inventory and Logistics, Field Service and Commissioning Support, the Critical Spare Parts program, and post-delivery Global Supply Managers (GSMs) — responsible for commissioning readiness and issue resolution across global operation. This organization owns the end-to-end (E2E) lifecycle of every piece of equipment from delivery through PFHO. Your primary responsibility is to drive successful, on-time PFHO on a global scale and to develop the leaders and the organization that deliver it — hiring and growing, setting a single strategy and quantifiable goals, and representing Post-Delivery to senior leadership and to partner organizations across Construction, Technical Infrastructure Program Managers (TIPMs), Design, Category Management, and suppliers.
This is a transformational, build-it mandate rather than a steady-state operations job. Today post-delivery work is scattered across functions as a part-time responsibility; you will consolidate it into one accountable organization, set its operating model, and raise its performance as AWS scales — exercising the judgment to decide where to invest, what to escalate, and how to influence the functions upstream and downstream of you.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own projects through completion.


Key job responsibilities
• Lead and build the organization — Hire, develop, and lead a team. Set direction and quantifiable goals, build the bench and succession for a largely new team, and establish a single, teachable standard of execution in place of individual improvisation. Developing leaders and growing the organization is the central, not peripheral, part of this role.
• Own on-time PFHO as a single-threaded leader — Carry end-to-end accountability for commissioning outcomes from delivery through PFHO, and be the senior escalation point and first line of defense for post-delivery construction and commissioning issues across the global build.
• Set the strategy — Own a multi-year Post-Delivery strategy anchored on a Site × Equipment commissioning-readiness framework, deciding where to concentrate commissioning enablers (Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) support and retainers, equipment and inventory redundancy, third-party field service, critical spare parts, and selective direct hires) against site and equipment criticality, and refreshing that strategy as the build evolves.
• Represent Post-Delivery to senior leadership — Communicate strategy, risk, and trade-offs concisely to executives; secure investment and air cover for cross-organizational moves; and influence partner organizations across Construction, TIPMs, Design, Category Management, and suppliers through authority and credibility rather than direct control.
• Run the operating mechanisms — Install the operating rhythm, metrics, and risk-management mechanisms that make on-time PFHO repeatable: forward-looking readiness over point-of-failure firefighting, a dynamic risk register across sites and suppliers, and feedback loops that drive recurring problems to their source.
• Scale what works and return capacity to partners — Scale proven commissioning programs (a supplier-managed Critical Spare Parts crash-cart, a Commissioning Success Scorecard, and Field Service Resource heatmaps) across the full supply base, and consolidate commissioning-phase ownership so Delivery GSMs regain the capacity for the sourcing and negotiation work only they can do.
• Success in this role directly impacts AWS’s ability to deliver data centers on schedule, measured by on-time PFHO, the health and growth of the organization you build, and the maturity of the mechanisms that sustain performance as the business scales.


A day in the life
• Set direction for your leaders, coach team.
• Communicate ideas concisely to a wide variety of stakeholders, for purposes ranging from informative to securing investment and approvals from executives.
• Embody a true pioneering spirit, willing to “get your hands dirty” in a start-up environment while simultaneously developing the strategy, processes, automation, and people that deliver results.
• Weigh competing priorities across many sites and suppliers, exercising high judgment on where to invest, what to escalate, and how to influence partners upstream and downstream.
• Develop and train leaders and teams to improve skills and capabilities for sustainable and continuous improvement.


About the team
*Why AWS* Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
*Diverse Experiences* Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
*Work/Life Balance* We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
*Inclusive Team Culture* Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon ( diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

title: Senior Account Executive, Amazon Business
descriptionHtml:
Come be a part of a rapidly expanding billion dollar global business. At Amazon Business, we set out every day to innovate and disrupt the status quo. We stand at the intersection of tech and retail, developing innovative purchasing and procurement solutions to help organisations reimagine buying. Bring your insight, imagination and a healthy disregard for the impossible. Join us in building and celebrating the value of Amazon Business to buyers and sellers of all sizes, unlocking our potential worldwide.

Amazon Business takes the selection, pricing and convenience customers already know from Amazon and adds what large organisations need to buy at scale: multi-user accounts, spend controls and approval workflows, business-only pricing, invoicing and payment terms, and direct integration into the purchasing and finance systems they already run. It is used by some of the largest enterprises, universities, hospitals and government departments in the world.

The problem we solve is one almost every large organisation recognises but few have fixed. Indirect spend — IT peripherals, tools, cleaning and office supplies, safety equipment and hundreds of other low-value, high-frequency purchases — is usually spread across dozens of suppliers, approved by hand, and invisible until the end of the quarter.

Australia is an early market for Amazon Business, targeting Enterprise and Strategic customers. You will own a named set of customers: some already buying with us and ready to scale enterprise-wide, others we have never sold to at all. There is no finished playbook to inherit. You will decide how these accounts are approached, and your decisions will visibly shape how Amazon Business covers this market.

Key job responsibilities
- Own a named set of Enterprise and Strategic accounts — including the account plan, the priorities and the revenue goal. Meet or exceed targets for both winning new customers and growing existing ones.
- Own all facets of the relationship for large, complex organisations, from first contact through to enterprise-wide expansion.
- Own the pipeline — drive how outreach and engagement is run, keep Salesforce accurate, and represent your territory in weekly and monthly business reviews.
- Build relationships up to VP (Vice President) and SVP (Senior Vice President) level, including Chief Procurement Officers and Heads of Procurement, and across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, IT and Facilities.
- Understand the customer's operational processes, workflows and enterprise systems well enough to design a solution that fits, then drive adoption of the capabilities that make buying stick.
- Lead complex negotiations to conclusion across multiple stakeholders and functions.
- Work with partner teams including professional services, integration specialists, marketing, retail/3P and customer services.
- Prepare strategic account plans and written narratives for internal executives and stakeholders.

A day in the life
No two days look the same. You might spend the morning with a customer's procurement leadership on their indirect spend, the afternoon with their IT or finance team on how Amazon Business connects to their purchasing system, and finish by writing the account plan that gets an internal decision made.

Your customers are Australian enterprises, universities, hospitals and government departments. Internally you will work with professional services, integration specialists, marketing, business development and customer service.

You will be trusted to run your territory like your own business, with a global team behind you when a deal needs it.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of prior work in business development, sales, or sales-engineering, preferably in the technology, internet and e-commerce sectors experience
- Experience in business development, sales, or sales-engineering, preferably in the technology, internet, and e-commerce sectors
- Experience positioning and selling innovative solutions to new and existing customers and market segments
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of procurement and source to pay processes and solutions or equivalent experience
- Experience in e-commerce
- Experience with data analysis (including advanced Excel and database analysis)
- Experience using Salesforce or other CRM tools
- Experience working in partner management within e-commerce or technology sectors

The JP Delivery Service Partner (DSP) organization is seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead our Cost Optimization and Network Losses charter.

As a Senior Program Manager in the JP DSP organization, you will own and execute the strategy to optimize cost-to-serve and minimize network losses across our delivery operations in Japan. This role is responsible for identifying and driving down the structural cost drivers of DSP operations, and for designing programs that reduce losses and leakage, such as lost, damaged, and misrouted packages, concessions, and payment inaccuracies. You will partner with Program, Product, Operations, Finance, and Technology teams across Last Mile to deliver long-term scalable solutions and improve process efficiency. You will be deeply connected to the data, possess a high degree of ownership, and make excellent decisions. A successful candidate will be highly analytical, be customer obsessed, able to overcome obstacles, and have excellent written and verbal communication. The candidate should be comfortable leading cross-functional business decisions, aligning partner teams, and recommending long-term solutions grounded in data. The ideal candidate will be someone who is comfortable rolling up their sleeves, has attention to detail, is comfortable with ambiguity, and has a passion for data.

Key job responsibilities
- Own DSP team's annual budget planning cycle and cost optimization agenda
- Identify structural drivers of cost-to-serve and lead strategic programs that reduce cost while protecting delivery quality and partner experience

title: Senior Recruiter, Principal Engineer Recruiting, PE Recruiting
descriptionHtml:
As a client lead recruiter, you'll have the unique opportunity to impact leadership teams across Amazon's diverse technology landscape, building relationships with Directors and VPs while shaping the future of Amazon's senior engineering community.



Key job responsibilities

• Serve as the primary talent advisor to Directors and VPs, educating leaders on the external senior engineering talent landscape and market dynamics
• Define and deliver recruiting strategies for highly-critical, sometimes confidential roles with broad cross-organizational impact
• Identify and engage highly passive senior engineering candidates through creative, research-driven sourcing strategies
• Build and cultivate robust talent networks across technology sectors, leveraging deep industry knowledge and relationships
• Lead client update meetings on active searches, providing clear, data-driven insights on progress and market conditions
• Provide candid guidance to executive leadership on matters related to top technical talent

• Conduct thorough candidate assessments, participate in debriefs, perform comprehensive reference checks, and present/negotiate employment offers
• Coach leaders to continuously improve their talent acquisition capabilities at the senior level
• Set exceptionally high standards for search quality, candidate experience, and recruiting excellence
• Investigate deeply into technical domains, candidate backgrounds, and market trends to inform strategy




A day in the life
Your day begins with strategic planning sessions discussing talent gaps and market intelligence for critical Principal Engineer searches. Mid-day might involve leading a client update meeting where you present market analysis and candidate pipeline progress, followed by conducting in-depth technical assessments with potential candidates. You'll collaborate with your team of recruiters and researchers, sharing insights on emerging talent pools and coaching colleagues. Afternoons often include candidate debriefs with hiring teams, where you provide perspective on technical depth and leadership potential. You'll also dedicate time to building relationships with industry leaders and technical communities, staying ahead of market trends. Throughout the day, you'll make high-stakes decisions with incomplete information, balancing urgency with thoroughness to secure world-class engineering talent.

The Global Specialty Recruiting (GSR) team partners with technical and business leaders across all of Amazon's businesses to hire the company's most senior engineering talent. title: Data Engineer II, AWS Analytics Engineering
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a talented Data Engineer to join our EC2 + EBS + Networking Product BI team. You will own end-to-end analytics for one or more Compute service areas — building and monitoring ETL pipelines, delivering executive reports, creating metrics and callouts on service performance, and producing deep-dive analyses that shape product roadmaps for services used by millions of AWS customers worldwide.



Key job responsibilities
• ETL Monitoring & Pipeline Operations: Own the reliability and timeliness of 200+ data pipelines serving executive-facing reports. Today, the team uses automated alarms for real-time monitoring and AI-powered agents that self-heal failures and triage tasks — you will maintain and extend this system using Redshift, orchestration frameworks, and AWS data services.
• Report Delivery & Business Reviews: Own and operate Weekly/Daily Business Review (WBR/DBR) reporting for EC2 services, ensuring accurate, timely delivery to CEO/S-Team and VP-level stakeholders. Today, report generation, validation, and delivery are automated via LLMs — you will operate and improve these workflows.
• Callout Generation: Generate callouts on service performance — identifying week-over-week trends, anomalies, and key drivers to surface in executive reviews. Today, callout generation across all 9 services is LLM-automated — you will own the quality bar and continuously improve prompt and pipeline accuracy.
• Data Ingestion & Metric Creation: Ingest new data sources and build metrics that track business health (usage, capacity, adoption, customer growth). Today, the team maintains scalable ETL pipelines in Redshift with workflow orchestration — you will ensure metrics remain sustainable, reproducible, and available on demand.
• Analysis & Deep Dives: Conduct deep-dive analyses for Product Managers, Sales, and Finance teams. Today, the team uses a proprietary analytics platform with governed SOPs, stored context, and pre-built queries — enabling any stakeholder to deep-dive with technical depth and reproducibility. You will author and maintain these SOPs and analyses.
• Dashboard Development: Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards (QuickSight, Weave) covering product trends, customer growth, instance utilization, and feature adoption. Today, dashboards serve 100+ Product Managers across 11 engagement areas — you will own dashboards for your service areas and improve self-serve capabilities.
• Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Product Managers, service finance teams, and cross-functional partners to translate business questions into data products and present findings to senior leaders. Today, the team partners across EC2, Networking, and Compute product families — you will be the primary analytics point of contact for your assigned service areas.

About the team
We are the EC2 + Networking Product BI team within AWS Analytics & Engineering (AAE). We serve as the data and analytics partner for Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), Networking Services, and adjacent Compute product families — supporting 100+ Product Managers across 11 engagement areas.
Our core work includes:
• ETL Pipeline Monitoring & Operations: We build and operate 200+ data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve petabyte-scale datasets across EC2, Networking, and Compute services. Reliability and timeliness are critical — our reports feed directly into CEO/S-Team weekly reviews. We use automated alarms for real-time pipeline monitoring and AI-powered agents to self-heal failures and triage tasks, minimizing manual intervention at this scale.
• Report Delivery & Callout Generation: We deliver Weekly and Daily Business Review (WBR/DBR) reports across 9 Compute services (EC2 Core, Gen AI, EBS, Bedrock, SageMaker, ECS, EKS, ECR, Lambda), generating callouts on service performance that inform executive decision-making. Report generation, validation, and callout generation are all done via LLMs — enabling consistent quality, accuracy, and speed at scale.
• Data Ingestion & Metric Creation: We design and maintain metrics that track business health — usage, capacity, adoption, customer growth — ensuring they are sustainable, reproducible, and available on demand.
• Analysis & Deep Dives: We produce analyses for Product Managers, Sales, and Finance teams using our proprietary analytics platform where governed SOPs, context, and prior work live. These SOPs help all PMs, Sales, and Finance stakeholders deep-dive with governed data, technical depth, and the right queries — enabling reproducibility and easy follow-ups across the organization.
Everything we build is designed to be sustainable, reproducible, and available on demand — so any team member can pick up, extend, or re-run work without starting from scratch.

- 3+ years of data engineering experience
- 3+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using ETL/ELT processes experience
- 3+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using OLAP technologies experience
- 3+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using data modeling experience
- 3+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using SQL experience
- 3+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using Oracle experience
- 3+ years of in the job offered or a related occupation experience

- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines

title: Hardware Validation Engineer, NPD Hardware
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services’ Network Products Development team is looking for experienced test professionals to help build our next generation networking platforms. The right candidate will play a key role in the design and development of our next generation Ethernet switching platforms for our world class data centers.

You will have previous experience testing network products. This includes reviewing designs for testability, developing manufacturing test plans, executing them, troubleshooting issues found during early prototype stages and transition to manufacturing. Compile and analyze production test data using automated data analysis techniques. You should be passionate about the role testing plays in achieving product reliability and quality. Applying skills in developing new test processes, test automation and debug is expected.

Key job responsibilities
* Develop and implement detailed validation plans tailored to specific hardware designs
* Collaborate with design and production teams to understand and test against product requirements
* Analyze and interpret data from validation tests, offering insights and recommendations
* Design and document validation processes, findings, and insights in a structured and clear manner
* Component specification study and component validation
* Oversee and plan the use of validation equipment to guarantee consistent results
* Work cross-functionally to troubleshoot and address any hardware issues identified during validation
* Second source qualification, cost down design validation and manufacturing efficiencies
* Support new product introduction and Sustaining engineering
* Develop and contribute in testing automation

A day in the life
On an everyday basis as part of our team, you have the unique opportunity to understand the growing AWS network and our internal customers’ requirement on interconnect solutions. You'll work backwards to devise hardware solutions by influencing the broad industry and/or to develop software
tools with sister teams to maintain a highly available network that delights AWS customers. You design and implement processes and mechanisms that both help the team to deliver business impact to the organization in a systemic way, while also helping to raise the bar on our operational excellence.

Operating at the scale we do, there is no blueprint for how to do what we do, which encourages our engineers to identify and develop simple solutions to complex problems. We encourage durable solutions that look around corners while taking into consideration our customer needs from a cost, performance, and reliability perspective. We work closely with our internal partners that design, build
and operate the network to ensure that our solutions meet their needs and exceed their expectations.

About the team
Within AWS Networking the NPD (Network Product Development) organization is responsible for, designing the hardware, building the software, and owning the interconnects for the routers that power the global AWS network. Beyond product delivery we actively manage the fleet or routers in a network that grows by 70% annually. This means tracking key business and operational metrics to ensure that we operate smoothly and minimize or eliminate customer impact due to device related issues for a transparent AWS customer experience.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. descriptionHtml:

As a WHS Manager, you'll be the site's safety champion, leading our Global WHS Program implementation. You'll combine hands-on safety management with strategic thinking to protect our most valuable asset – our people. Your role bridges the gap between safety requirements and operational success, requiring both technical expertise and strong interpersonal skills. Working closely with Operations leadership, you'll drive safety initiatives that make a real difference. You'll conduct comprehensive risk assessments, analyze safety data, and implement practical solutions that protect associates while supporting productivity. Your ability to build relationships and influence positive change will be essential as you help shape our safety culture. You'll lead safety compliance efforts, conduct thorough site audits, and analyze incident trends to target improvements where they matter most. Managing our first aid program and emergency response capabilities, you'll ensure immediate care is always available. Your analytical skills will transform safety data into actionable insights, while your leadership abilities will help engage associates in our safety mission.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Leadership & Innovation - Transform safety culture through leadership and innovative solutions. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that set new benchmarks in workplace safety. Leverage technology and data analytics to drive preventive safety measures that protect our associates while enhancing operational excellence. Develop leadership plans, communicate expectations, and drive initiatives to create a safe work environment. Measure performance against WHS policies, analyze metrics, and conduct site audits to address non-compliance issues.

Strategic Partnership & Influence - Build partnerships with Operations leadership to integrate safety into every aspect of our business. Use compelling data analysis and risk insights to influence positive change and drive strategic decision-making. The HR Partner role offers an exceptional opportunity to build your career in human resources, focusing on employee experience, engagement, leadership development and HR operational excellence.

As an HR Partner on the NACF PXT team, you will support PXT operations through consistent standard work execution, relationship-building, and timely issue resolution. With a visible presence across site operations, you'll foster team culture, support engagement, and coach leaders on PXT practices. You'll create positive employee experiences while building your skills in navigating increasingly complex issues and influencing without authority. - Support a positive employee experience by executing key programs, reinforcing workplace standards, and partnering with PXT and Operations to create a culture where employees feel valued, heard, and supported.

- Execute standard work with consistent quality and timeliness, meeting established service level agreements (SLAs) and maintaining accurate documentation of HR processes and employee interactions.

title: Senior Human Rights Due Diligence Advisor, WW Sustainability
descriptionHtml:
Join us at the forefront of Amazon's sustainability initiatives to work on environmental and social advancements that support Amazon's long-term worldwide sustainability strategy. At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about making a meaningful impact on communities and the environment while helping shape the future of sustainable business practices.

The Worldwide Sustainability (WWS) organization capitalizes on Amazon's scale and speed to build a more resilient and sustainable company. We manage our social and environmental impacts globally and drive solutions that enable our customers, businesses, and the world to become more sustainable. Through innovative programs and strategic partnerships, we're creating lasting positive change in the communities where we operate while advancing Amazon's commitment to environmental stewardship and social responsibility.

Amazon's Human Rights & Social Impact program drives customer trust, business continuity, and sustainable social impact by embedding respect for human rights throughout Amazon’s entire value chain. We implement company-wide standards and commitments such as our Global Human Rights Principles (GHRP) and Supply Chain Standards (SCS). We seek to continuously improve the tools and processes used in integrating human rights due diligence across the business. We work with businesses across Amazon to embed and scale respect for human rights. Within HRSI, the Human Rights Due Diligence (HRDD) team works with businesses to identify and prioritize human rights risks across the value chain, and develops the methodologies that assess those risks and measure the performance of business efforts to prevent and mitigate harm.

We are hiring a Senior Human Rights Due Diligence Advisor to serve as a specialized subject matter expert operating at the intersection of two areas: (1) due diligence advisory services and (2) methodology and tool development. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can work both strategically and tactically, operate with limited guidance in ambiguous problem spaces, and act as the primary point of accountability for complex human rights due diligence work.

As a trusted advisor to HRSI teams, Worldwide Sustainability partners, and business customers, you will own multiple or complex business relationships, conduct end-to-end risk analyses, and translate international human rights standards into operational guidance. Critically, you will not only bring deep knowledge of frameworks such as the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights; you will operationalize them by designing quantitative, data-driven methodologies and risk scoring logics that make human rights risk measurable and comparable at enterprise scale. You will also serve as a single-threaded leader for methodology and tool development, defining the strategy and frameworks that enable the entire team's success.


Key job responsibilities
- Own multiple or complex business relationships for human rights due diligence, serving as the primary point of accountability for assigned businesses.
- Work with businesses to identify and prioritize human rights risks across the value chain.
- Conduct end-to-end risk analyses, write comprehensive risk reports, and translate findings into actionable insights for business stakeholders.
- Design and develop quantitative, data-driven methodologies and risk scoring logics that assess human rights risk and measure the performance of business efforts to prevent and mitigate harm.
- Act as a single-threaded leader (STL) for the end-to-end development of enterprise due diligence methodologies and tools, often in ambiguous contexts where the desired outcome is not previously defined.
- Partner with other HRDD advisors to understand their use cases and needs, defining strategy and frameworks that enable the broader team to succeed.
- Assess risks across differing business models, supply chain structures, and regulatory environments while maintaining a big-picture view of how human rights risks connect to business goals and compliance requirements.
- Serve as a trusted advisor to HRSI teams and Amazon businesses, translating international standards into operational realities.

Basic qualifications

- - Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., human rights, international development, law, sustainability, social sciences, or related).
- - 8+ years of experience in human rights, sustainability, ESG, responsible sourcing, or corporate due diligence.
- - Demonstrated knowledge of international human rights frameworks, particularly the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights and the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises.
- - Experience developing quantitative, data-driven risk methodologies or scoring logics that translate qualitative standards into measurable, comparable outputs.
- - Familiarity with human rights due diligence regulation (e.g., CSDDD, CSRD, national supply chain due diligence and modern slavery laws).
- - Experience conducting human rights or value chain risk assessments and translating findings into actionable recommendations for business stakeholders.
- - Pragmatic operator who thrives in a fast-paced environment, working across functions and business teams with competing priorities to find actionable, high-judgment solutions. Skilled at translating human rights standards into practical approaches that deliver value to the business while delivering for people.
- - Experience working independently on complex or ambiguous programs with limited guidance.

Preferred qualifications

- - Advanced degree in human rights, law, international affairs, sustainability, or a related discipline.
- - Experience developing due diligence methodologies, frameworks, or tools for use across an enterprise or multiple business units.
- - Experience building risk scoring models or measurement frameworks in partnership with data science, analytics, or product teams.
- - Experience serving as a single-threaded leader or program owner driving alignment across cross-functional stakeholders (science, product, legal, and business teams).
- - Experience advising senior leaders and building durable stakeholder relationships across a large, complex organization.

descriptionHtml:

This role involves initiating and supporting the implementation of the regulatory and Safety standards within EU AIR, ensuring alignment with Operations internal and external partners. You will identify improvement opportunities and influence cross-functional stakeholders. You will thrive in a flexible environment and not be hindered by ambiguity. Strong judgment, analytic talent, and ownership are essential. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders to understand high-priority execution targets and drive measurable impacts across Global Program frameworks. You will work across business units and geographies to support the development of long-term strategies and operational direction for WHS programs. You will be a motivated Safety Specialist with a proven record of developing team members’ competencies.

Key job responsibilities
Own end-to-end aviation safety oversight for the assigned perimeter, including quarterly gateway assessments, scheduled and ad-hoc site visits, structured audits with 3P carriers, and compliance monitoring against Amazon AIR WHS standards, local/national legislation, and EU aviation regulations, proactively identifying gaps and implementing remediation plans



Manage safety investigations and incident prevention programs, conducting root cause analysis for incidents and precursor events, leveraging trend data and industry best practices to drive corrective actions to verified closure and mitigate risks before they materialise



Support EU Gateway WHS Safety Oversight Programs and new gateway launches, including safety readiness assessments, protocol development, and ongoing monitoring frameworks



Proactively identify safety risks and drive process improvements across the 3P network to enhance operational efficiency, reduce incident rates, and strengthen safety culture



Generate in-depth safety analyses and maintain accurate documentation, using internal reporting tools, precursor event data, and operational metrics to produce actionable recommendations and ensure data integrity for regulatory reporting and trend identification



Partner across internal teams, 3P suppliers, carriers, and ground handling agents to implement scalable safety solutions and cross-functional process improvements, support cross-regional WHS collaboration on standardised frameworks, contribute to safety-related projects and business reviews, and drive adoption of safety technologies, automation, and digitalisation initiatives to enhance oversight capabilities

About the team
The EU AIR Safety Team ensures the highest aviation safety standards across Amazon Air's European third-party (3P) air gateways and collaborates with India WHS teams to support the India AIR network. We manage safety compliance across Europe and the UK through proactive risk management, regulatory compliance, data-driven decision making, and continuous innovation.

- Experience working within a global company, with multi-country responsibilities
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization

descriptionHtml:
Come lead a talented group of SDEs as they build payment experiences for our Brazilian customers. You will lead a cross-geographical group of SDEs and TPMs across owning the end-to-end technical roadmap for Brazil Payments. You will build a culture of AI-native development. Not just using AI as a coding assistant, but rethinking how your team approaches architecture, testing, and delivery with AI at the center. You will build solutions where AI is a core component of the product (intelligent payment method recommendation, fraud-aware routing, personalized affordability etc.) and set the bar that your team wouldn't build it any other way.

descriptionHtml:
Do you want to help shape how the world's most advanced AI models get built? AWS is hiring a Principal Go-To-Market (GTM) Specialist for Amazon FSx for Lustre, the high-performance file system behind some of the most demanding compute workloads on the planet. FSx for Lustre is a core part of the AWS Generative AI strategy. It feeds data to accelerated compute at the speed needed for training, fine-tuning, and inference at scale.

In this role, you will work with frontier model providers, fast-growing AI startups, and global enterprises as they build and scale their AI and HPC infrastructure on AWS. You will set the worldwide GTM strategy for FSx for Lustre and create and run programs, initiatives, research, and enablement at scale for our WW sales, specialist, partner, and cross-functional teams. Your work will directly shape how customers choose AWS as the place to build, train, and deploy AI.

To succeed in this role, you need a proven track record of building and executing GTM and sales programs at scale with measurable results, along with a strong understanding of HPC and AI/ML infrastructure.

In this role, you will be accountable for:

- Setting the WW GTM strategy for FSx for Lustre. Define strategic program direction and oversee execution of insight-driven programs that grow FSx for Lustre adoption and AWS market share with frontier model builders, AI-native startups, and enterprise AI and HPC customers.
- Driving GenAI and HPC workload adoption. Use your business judgment to drive revenue, build sales plays, and find new markets and opportunities across model training, fine-tuning, inference, and traditional HPC workloads such as genomics, EDA, seismic processing, financial simulation, and autonomous vehicle development.
- Working directly with the most demanding customers. Engage with leading AI labs, model providers, and enterprises to understand their performance, scale, and data pipeline needs, and turn them into product feedback, customer wins, and repeatable patterns.
- Partnering across AWS. Work with Compute (accelerated instances and UltraClusters), Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, Amazon EKS, Amazon S3, the Startups and Generative AI teams, industry teams, and service teams to align on joint GTM motions and find the workloads that drive FSx for Lustre growth.
- Mapping technology to business outcomes. Help customers understand how high-performance storage speeds up time to train, improves accelerator utilization, and lowers the total cost of AI and HPC infrastructure.
