Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

title: Solutions Architect, AI Transformation, Enterprise, Enterprise Solutions Architecture, Switzerland
descriptionHtml:
As a Solutions Architect, you are the trusted technical advisor to your customers, partnering with them across their journey on AWS. You work with enterprise customers to understand their goals, design the architectures that get them there, and guide them from first conversation through to production. You are comfortable moving between the whiteboard with a customer's architects and the boardroom with their executive sponsors, and you earn trust by being genuinely useful at both.

This role carries that generalist Solutions Architect mandate with a focus on AI transformation. It spans both sides of that work: helping customers transform how they build, applying AI across the development lifecycle (AIDLC), and helping them transform their business with AI. You help customers understand what is genuinely possible, separate what is ready from what is not, and build the architectures and the confidence to put AI into production.

You work closely with the AI teams, and you help customers connect AI capability to real business outcomes rather than experiments.

Key job responsibilities
Act as the trusted technical advisor for your customers across their adoption of AWS, from early strategy conversations through architecture, build and production.

Lead technical deep-dives, architecture reviews, workshops and proof-of-concept engagements that move customers from AI ambition to a design they can deploy.

Design AI/ML and generative-AI architectures: model selection, retrieval and data pipelines, agentic patterns, evaluation, cost and latency trade-offs, and the security and data-residency requirements customers bring to every conversation.

Apply and promote AIDLC practices, helping customers change how they build using AI across the development lifecycle, and connect that to measurable business outcomes.

Help customers build evaluation frameworks that measure models against their own success criteria, so production-readiness decisions rest on evidence.

Own the technical narrative across audiences, from implementation detail with engineering teams to business-value framing with CTOs, Chief Data Officers and executive sponsors.

Share knowledge with the wider Solutions Architecture and Account Management community, raising the team's collective depth in AI.

Capture patterns and friction from customer engagements and feed them back to AWS service teams as concrete product input.

Produce reference architectures and technical content, and represent AWS at customer briefings and industry events.

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a working session with a Swiss enterprise customer's leadership, mapping where generative AI can change how their teams build software and run operations. Next, you join their engineers to design an agentic solution on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and talk through security, cost and scale. After lunch, you run a hands-on AI-DLC workshop with the account team, then build a proof of concept that turns a promising idea into a measurable pilot. You end the day sharing what you learned with the wider SA community and passing customer feedback to AWS service teams.

Basic qualifications

- Experience building with AI/ML, including generative AI (foundation models, retrieval-augmented generation, or agentic patterns)
- Experience applying AI/ML to software development and/or business transformation use cases
- Experience designing, implementing, or consulting on applications and/or infrastructure
- Experience in a customer-facing or client-facing technical role

Preferred qualifications

- Experience delivering AI/ML and generative-AI workloads in production on any cloud or platform
- Knowledge of enterprise customer segments and how large organizations adopt new technology
- Experience in a specific technology domain (e.g. software development, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics)
- Professional working proficiency in French (local language in Geneva) or German alongside English

title: Security Assurance Specialist , AWS Compliance & Security Assurance
descriptionHtml:
At AWS, Security is priority zero. AWS Compliance, Assurance, and Privacy Services (CAPS) is looking for an experienced security controls specialist to serve as a steward for a portfolio of security and compliance control areas. These areas sit where technology, policy and business process meet, including areas such as regulatory obligations, data governance, logging and monitoring, and supply chain risk. You won't operate the controls yourself. Instead, you'll work with the teams who do to clearly capture how their controls are designed, implemented and evidenced. That way, the control's purpose and effectiveness are understood across AWS, from service and leadership teams to the compliance and audit teams who represent those controls externally. You'll make sure the controls in your areas are well defined, clearly documented, consistent with one another, and give the right scope and coverage for AWS's compliance obligations. You'll work with control owners and senior stakeholders across Legal, Privacy, Procurement, Security and Engineering to turn complex requirements into clear, testable controls. CAPS works across AWS to drive strategic security initiatives, deliver tooling and automation, and support customers in regulated industries such as Healthcare, Finance and Government.

The ideal candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, can influence senior leaders without direct authority, and can explain technical and regulatory concepts clearly to legal, business and engineering audiences.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:
* Partner with control owners to clearly document how their controls are designed, implemented and evidenced, so internal stakeholders and audit-facing teams understand what each control does and how well it works.
* Assess the overall shape of your control areas: find gaps, overlaps and conflicts, and make sure controls work together and give appropriate coverage.
* Work with control owners and senior stakeholders across Legal, Privacy, Procurement, Security and Engineering to translate regulatory, contractual and policy requirements into actionable, testable controls.
*Build a deep understanding of the operational processes, services and controls that support AWS's security and compliance posture, and how they map to our internal control framework and assessment processes.
* Evaluate the risk profile of emerging AI platforms and capabilities, and reflect those risks in control design and assessment processes.
* Support service, feature and control assessments for customer, regulatory and audit requirements, and give audit-facing teams the context they need on control design and intent.
* Identify high-risk areas and work with control owners and service teams to drive remediation and process improvement.
* Help design and deliver tooling and automation that simplifies control documentation, evidence collection and compliance reporting.
* Build consensus across organizations, raise risks clearly, and help senior leaders reach decisions.
* Communicate program status, risks and outcomes to stakeholders at all levels.

A day in the life
* Dive deep into the AWS control environment to understand how controls are implemented, and explain their compliance implications to internal stakeholders and audit-facing teams.
* Set direction for your control areas, improve documentation, track progress, coordinate improvement efforts, and measure whether those improvements are working.
* Build broad domain and technical knowledge of AWS security, including the operational processes and controls that support AWS compliance programs.
* Act as a trusted advisor, facilitator and creative problem solver for control owners and stakeholders.
* Develop and share frameworks, tools and best practices that teams across the organization can adopt.
* Help the teams that work with auditors by explaining how controls are implemented and what they cover, and by applying security, privacy and compliance concepts to a technical cloud environment.
* Communicate program results, including assessment status, workflow, remediation and reporting, to a broad audience that includes peers and senior leaders.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas, including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing learning experiences inspire us to keep growing and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in security, audits, customer trust, control assessments, or risk assessments.
- 3+ years of experience assessing complex technical processes
- Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems Management, Mathematics, Accounting/Auditing, or other related fields or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with audit or risk program design, control environment process documentation, and control mapping
- Experience with monitoring and automating security controls.
- Experience in third-party and/or internal audit examinations.
- Demonstrates high judgement and risk decision making abilities.
- Have experience in performing technical assessments and documentation of network, operating systems, application security, as well as auditing IT processes, including working knowledge of key controls across a number of industry best practices.
- Experience understanding the risk profile of emerging AI technologies.

title: Fire Protection Engineer, Data Center Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to apply your fire protection expertise to data center infrastructure that operates at a global scale? Are you excited about expanding your knowledge of building systems while contributing insights from your previous experience?

In this role, you will influence all aspects of fire protection design, construction, operations, and maintenance for our data centers. This includes fire suppression, fire detection, fire alarm, and mass notification systems, as well as fire-resistant construction and life safety. You will work with internal and external teams to define, design, detail, and document the fire protection features our facilities require, using both prescriptive and performance-based design approaches. You will contribute your expertise to the continual improvement of our fire protection design standards, ensuring our buildings protect people and keep our customers' data safe and uninterrupted over the life of each facility.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and oversee fire water service infrastructure, including water supply analysis, coordination with utilities and fire officials, and establishing site-level requirements for fire protection systems.
- Review concept designs and construction documents from third-party vendors to verify compliance with established design standards, local codes, National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) standards, International Code Council (ICC) requirements, and Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) expectations.
- Prepare prescriptive and performance-based designs for building fire suppression, alarm, and detection systems, and coordinate fire protection system space requirements, supporting utilities, and equipment locations.
- Collaborate with construction, commissioning, operations, and risk management teams to resolve requests for information, value engineering queries, and technical questions throughout the project lifecycle.
- Drive improvement of fire protection design standards and standard configuration templates across the organization, simplifying and strengthening systems with each iteration.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing active project designs, checking that fire protection elements meet our standards and local code requirements. You may join a cross-functional call with architects, mechanical engineers, and construction managers to align on system layouts for a new build, then shift to evaluating a vendor's submittal package for a fire alarm system. In the afternoon, you might prepare a performance-based design analysis or meet with local fire officials to secure approval of fire protection features. Throughout, you will mentor teammates and share lessons learned to improve quality across the team.

About the team
Our Data Center Design Engineering team includes architects, structural, mechanical, electrical, civil, fire protection, and controls engineers working together to design the next generation of data centers at Amazon. We are committed to delivering world-class uptime for our customers and we build facilities that emphasize security, safety, and efficiency while meeting growing demand. As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to directly impact our business and contribute to continuous advancements in how we design and build infrastructure at scale.

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel

title: Senior Worldwide Specialist Sales, Amazon Connect (CXE), AWS
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 15, 2026

This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges.

AWS is one of Amazon’s fastest growing businesses, servicing millions of customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises consume information technology and powering the developers who are building the next generation of global industry leaders. AWS customers include some of the most innovative startups like Netflix, Pinterest, Airbnb, and Instagram as well as some of the largest global enterprises like Shell International, Unilever, Hitachi, Sharp, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Samsung.

AWS is seeking an experienced Senior Sales Specialist to help us establish AWS as the market leader for Amazon Connect - Amazon’s Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS). This effort is in direct response to feedback from customers and seeks to address the daily pain points of meeting the high bar of delivering great customer service. This service will offer a compelling alternative for our customers when faced with multiple components, channels and vendors, managing long term commitments and very complex pricing models, and scaling based upon the specific needs of their businesses. This exciting service is part of the growing SaaS offerings from AWS such as Amazon Supply Chain and Clean Rooms. The ideal candidate will have enterprise sales experience in areas such as telecommunications, VoIP, CRM/ERP applications, call/contact center and/or the integration of these complex solutions, be a self-starter, and be willing to operate both tactically and strategically. As key team member in this fast growing, exciting space you will have the opportunity to help drive the growth and shape the future of a service category that will have a significant impact on our customers’ business.

title: Applied Scientist III - Amazon Identity Program, Amazon Identity Program (AIP)
descriptionHtml:
Advertising identity is one of the most challenging problems in modern machine learning. Amazon Advertising is looking for an Applied Scientist III to help solve it at global scale, applying advanced AI, graph neural networks, and probabilistic modeling to connect billions of identity signals across devices, publishers, and the open internet.

The Amazon Advertising Identity Platform (AIP) powers how advertisers recognize, reach, and measure audiences across the advertising ecosystem. As traditional identity signals become less available and consumer behavior spans an increasing number of devices and environments, we are investing in new scientific approaches to build a more accurate, scalable, and privacy conscious identity graph.

As a senior scientific leader, you will develop novel approaches to probabilistic identity resolution, graph neural networks (GNNs), representation learning, and large scale entity matching. You will combine deterministic identity signals from Amazon's owned and operated properties with signals from publishers, agencies, and third party identity providers to build accurate identity models across increasingly fragmented digital environments.

You will define scientific direction, design and evaluate new models, and partner closely with engineering and product teams to bring research into production. Your work will directly influence advertising addressability, audience reach, campaign measurement, and billions of dollars in advertising revenue.

The ideal candidate has deep expertise in applied machine learning, graph algorithms, and probabilistic modeling, with a demonstrated ability to translate scientific research into production systems. You should be comfortable operating in ambiguous problem spaces, challenging existing approaches, mentoring scientists, and influencing technical strategy across organizations.

This role offers the opportunity to shape the future of identity resolution at Amazon, advance the state of the art in applied machine learning, and deliver scientific innovations with measurable impact across the global advertising industry.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
- Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

title: Data Center Facility Manager-Nights, Data Center Community
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are seeking an Data Center Facility Manager to serve as a technical resource and leader within Amazon data centers. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of data center operations. The Data Center Facility Manager is responsible for the overall operation and maintenance of all electrical, mechanical, and HVAC equipment within the data center. The Data Center Facility Manager will assist in maintaining a high reliability and performance while keeping operating costs in facilities at a minimum. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

This role will be managing a night shift team. Overnight hours are between 8pm-7am.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Relocation assistance will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities

- Manage teams of 24x7 engineering technicians in all facets of their career
- Engage in improvement projects, often requiring reaching out to a variety of support teams, and drive them from conception to completion
- Coordinates daily with a multitude of third party vendors ensuring adherence to contracted SLAs
- Effectively and efficiently manage the operations budget and expenditures

Additionally, you will play a crucial role in process optimization, staff management, setting performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives, all while ensuring a supportive and inclusive work environment.

- Manage teams of 24x7 engineering technicians: Prioritize and assign tasks, coach and create documentation, guide and train staff on best practices.
- Effectively and efficiently manage operations budget: Monitor and control expenditures, ensure optimal resource allocation.
- Engage in improvement projects: Drive projects from conception to completion, collaborate with support teams.
- Coordinate with third-party vendors: Ensure adherence to contracted service level agreements (SLAs).
- Communicate complex technical information: Adapt communication style for diverse stakeholders, including non-technical audiences.
- Respond to out-of-hours emergency calls: Address urgent issues that may arise outside regular working hours.
- Act as an escalation point for facilities-related issues: Oversee routine and emergency services, ensure safety procedures are followed.
- Deliver operational excellence: Prioritize team development and well-being while achieving operational goals.
- Foster a diverse and inclusive team culture: Empower team members to reach their full potential.
- Perform physical tasks: Lift and move objects of varying weights, walk job sites in different terrains while maintaining balance and safety.
- Promote accessible work environments: Support employees' diverse needs.

- Support multiple locations/sites: Coordinate and manage operations across different sites.
- Provide on-site management for builders, five days a week. (No remote work)

- 3+ years of electrical or mechanical experience
- 3+ years of engineering, installation, or startup/commissioning of electrical and mechanical systems experience

Preferred qualifications

title: Principal Technical Product Manager, Amazon Quick
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Quick is the AI companion for work. Today, thousands of enterprises and millions of users rely on Quick to connect their data, understand it quickly, and take action: whether through interactive dashboards, embedded analytics woven into the products their customers use, natural language experiences that let any knowledge worker ask a question and act on the answer immediately, or fully managed tools they build and deploy for their stakeholders. Hundreds of ISVs and SaaS companies have already built Quick into the fabric of their applications, powering experiences for millions of end users. That is the kind of reach we operate at, and we are just getting started.

The Opportunity

We are at an inflection point. The way users and businesses manage their commerce workflows is about to change fundamentally. Buying, selling, and operating across Amazon's commerce surfaces still runs on fragmented dashboards, manual reporting, and context scattered across disconnected tools. The convergence of structured data, natural language, and agentic AI collapses that friction: an agent that understands your business, acts across every tool you use, and turns a question into completed work. Quick sits at the center of this shift. We are building the companion where a seller optimizes operations, a buyer streamlines procurement, and a vendor acts on insight, all in plain English, all before the day is over. Amazon operates the world's largest commerce surfaces, and the next wave of value comes from Quick integrating tightly with Amazon Business, Amazon Sellers, and Vendors so that buyers, sellers, and vendors manage their business inside Quick with full context across every tool they use. Your mandate is to make Quick the agentic workspace where commerce happens, with Quick as the connective layer across Amazon's commerce ecosystem. You will work across S-team orgs spanning Amazon Business, Sellers, Vendors, and AWS, setting direction, aligning priorities, and building the partnerships that make this integration real.

Who You Are

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager, Technical to own this journey. You are a deeply technical product leader, equal parts strategist and practitioner: someone who sets the multi-year vision for a market, influences senior leaders across organizations, and still rolls up their sleeves to ship the next release; who works backward from the customer's deployment, not from a requirements document, and measures success by whether the customer succeeded; who sees a nascent, fast-growing business not as a risk but as a canvas.

Why Join

You will have a direct, visible thumbprint on the companion that is becoming the front door for agentic commerce across Amazon's ecosystem. The decisions you make, about what we build, how we package it, who we build it for, and how we bring it to market, will define how businesses buy, sell, and operate in the age of AI. If you are a builder who gets energy from ambiguity, thinks in systems but ships in increments, and wants to be at the frontier where commerce meets agentic AI, we want to talk to you.

descriptionHtml:

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors

Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities

Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues

Helping to train and onboard new team members

Physical requirements:

Working in cramped and/or elevated locations

Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching

Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day

Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

As a Data Center Technician professional, you have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while you:

title: System Development Engineer, Amazon Leo, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations with or without reliable connectivity. Our Payload Integration and Testing (PIT) team validates the end-to-end network interface communication system both on the ground prior to launch and in-orbit to ensure we are providing customers a best-in-class experience. We're the final software quality gate, ensuring what customers experience on-orbit matches our design intent.

As a System Development Engineer, you'll design and build the test automation framework and procedures that validate our satellite network end to end -- and the full stack it runs on, from the device-interface layer that drives physical hardware up through the infrastructure and operational tooling that keep our hardware-in-the-loop (HILT) test venues running reliably at scale. You'll write the automation frameworks and test harnesses that exercise the system, the low-level interface code and device drivers that let those harnesses command and read back from lab hardware over protocols like serial/UART, I2C/SPI, USB, Ethernet, and instrument-control interfaces, and the compute, networking, provisioning, and observability underneath that keep it all healthy. The technical scope is broad and systems-oriented: you'll build test-orchestration and automation software, architect and automate cloud and on-premise infrastructure, integrate and bring up lab hardware down to the register and command level, and drive the operational excellence practices that keep a high-stakes, 24/7 test environment reliable. If you love building test automation, enjoy working at the intersection of software, networking, and physical hardware, and want to solve unique operational challenges in the space domain, this is an exceptional opportunity.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and maintain test automation frameworks, test harnesses, and orchestration software that validate the satellite network end to end

- Develop automated test suites and the tooling engineers use to author, run, schedule, and debug tests across distributed HITL venues

- Write and maintain the low-level interface code and device drivers that let test systems command and read back from lab hardware over protocols such as serial/UART, I2C/SPI, USB, Ethernet, and instrument-control interfaces (e.g., SCPI)

- Perform device bring-up and integration: understand hardware command sets and register maps, debug at the protocol level, and build the abstraction layers that expose hardware to higher-level test automation

- Design, build, and operate the infrastructure and networking that connects distributed hardware-in-the-loop test venues to cloud services

- Automate provisioning, configuration, and deployment of test environments using infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines

- Build and own monitoring, alarming, dashboards, and observability for test orchestration systems and the infrastructure they depend on

- Drive operational excellence: on-call response, incident management, root-cause analysis, and systemic fixes that prevent recurrence

- Identify and resolve systemic reliability, scaling, and performance issues across the test stack -- automation, compute, network, and storage

- Collaborate with software engineers, applied scientists, systems engineers, and test teams to translate test and operational requirements into robust automation and infrastructure

- Write clean, maintainable, well-documented software following engineering best practices, and participate in design and code reviews

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
- Experience in Linux OS and network troubleshooting, or experience in Linux and Networking protocols and experience in networking administration and troubleshooting
- 3+ years of professional software development experience, including building test automation, tooling, or production systems
- Experience designing and building automated test frameworks, test harnesses, or test orchestration software
- Experience interfacing software with physical hardware at a low level -- e.g., writing or debugging device-control code over serial/UART, I2C/SPI, USB, GPIO, or instrument-control protocols, and reading hardware command/register documentation
- Understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls) and the ability to diagnose connectivity issues
- Experience building and operating production infrastructure, including automated provisioning and deployment

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with distributed systems at scale
- Experience building large-scale or distributed test automation for hardware-in-the-loop, embedded, or networked systems
- Experience with AWS infrastructure services (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch) and infrastructure-as-code (CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform)
- Background building CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, or deployment automation from scratch
- Knowledge of orchestration systems, workflow engines, or event-driven architectures
- Experience writing device drivers or low-level firmware, or developing against embedded/RTOS or bare-metal targets
- Familiarity with hardware debugging tools (logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, JTAG/protocol analyzers) and board bring-up
- Experience supporting lab, test, or manufacturing environments with physical hardware in the loop
- Experience with containers and virtualization (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS)
- Demonstrated experience with monitoring, alarming, and operational excellence practices
- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively under time pressure
- Experience working in startup environments or fast-paced, high-growth teams
- Passion for simplifying complex problems and building flexible, maintainable systems

Come join our offensive security team dedicated to the detection and exploitation of vulnerabilities affecting Amazon consumer devices. You will strive to understand systems, software, and services deeply and develop creative ways to break assumptions in order to find vulnerabilities. You care deeply about keeping Amazon customers safe and therefore are passionate about mitigating vulnerabilities/risks by providing actionable guidance to product teams and drive long term security improvements. You're well-known for your excellent prioritization skills as well as your ability to communicate at all levels of an organization.

If you're passionate about finding security bugs, writing tools to reduce manual testing, and enjoy seeing your work's impact across Amazon consumer products and services, then this position is for you. Candidates from entry to senior level will all be considered.
